new_roles.title: Director, Quality Engineering
new_roles.description:
HHAeXchange is the leading technology platform for home and community-based care. Founded in 2008, HHAeXchange was born out of an idea to create a fully comprehensive end-to-end homecare solution to help people who are aging or have disabilities thrive in their homes and communities. Our employees are passionate about transforming the healthcare space by building the only homecare ecosystem that fully connects patients, personal care providers, managed care organizations, and states.

The Director, Quality Engineering will lead the enterprise-wide quality strategy and Quality Assurance (QA) program across HHAeXchange. This role is responsible for standardizing testing processes and tools, driving test automation, and ensuring our products meet high standards for reliability, performance, security, and accessibility. The Director, Quality Engineering will oversee functional and non-functional testing practices, including accessibility (WCAG) and security-related validation, and will own processes that support customer User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates located in the EST or CST time zones within the US only.**

### **Essential Job Duties**

* **Enterprise Quality Leadership:** Develop, implement, and lead the overall quality strategy and QA operating model across the organization.
* **Standardize Testing Processes:** Define and enforce consistent testing approaches including test planning, test cases, regression strategy, and release readiness criteria.
* **Tooling Ownership:** Select, implement, and manage enterprise testing tools for test management, automation, performance, accessibility, and security validation.
* **Automation Strategy:** Drive increased automated test coverage across UI, API, mobile, and services, reducing reliance on manual regression testing.
* **Compliance, Accessibility & VPAT Reporting:**
 + Lead accessibility testing programs aligned to WCAG 2.1+
 + Oversee creation and maintenance of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) and Accessibility Conformance Reports
 + Partner with Product, Legal, and Compliance to respond to customer accessibility requirements and audits
* **Security & Compliance Testing Support:** Coordinate with Security teams on SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation, and remediation tracking.
* **Customer UAT Support:**
 + Define and support customer UAT strategies and environments
 + Provide test plans, data guidance, and defect triage support during customer acceptance testing cycles
 + Ensure feedback from UAT informs release decisions and product quality improvements
* **Quality Metrics & Reporting:** Establish KPIs to measure product quality, defect escape rate, automation coverage, UAT outcomes, and release readiness; communicate results to leadership.
* **Shift-Left Quality Practices:** Embed quality earlier in the development lifecycle through collaboration on requirements, acceptance criteria, and CI/CD integration.
* **Incident & Defect Management:** Oversee defect triage for high-priority production and pre-production issues and ensure timely resolution and root-cause prevention.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Compliance to ensure alignment of quality practices across releases.
* **Organizational Leadership**: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of QA engineers, SDETs, automation engineers, and accessibility/compliance testers.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify quality gaps and drive process improvements that improve product reliability, reduce rework, and increase delivery confidence.
* **Release Governance:** Participate in release readiness reviews and serve as a key stakeholder in go/no-go decisions.
* **Coding agent advocacy:** **Help onboard team members to AI development tools. Share techniques, prompt patterns, and review practices that make AI-augmented development effective and safe in a regulated environment.**

### **Other Job Duties**

* Other duties as assigned by supervisor or HHAeXchange leader.

### **Travel Requirements**

* Travel up to 10%, including overnight travel

### **Required Education, Experience, Certifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering within a software product company, with a focus on developing scalable, high-performance systems.
* 4+ years leading QA organizations or enterprise quality programs.
* Proven experience designing and implementing standardized QA processes and test automation strategies in SaaS environments.
* Hands-on experience implementing automated testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with accessibility testing and standards such as WCAG 2.1+ and authoring VPATs/ACRs.
* Experience supporting security testing practices such as vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST, and penetration test remediation validation.
* Experience supporting or running customer UAT processes.
* Strong understanding of quality metrics (defect rates, coverage, MTTR, escape rate, etc.) and how to operationalize them.
* Background working in cloud-based architectures and microservices environments.
* Demonstrated success collaborating across engineering, product, and security teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing QA and automation teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical partners.
* **AI/ML fundamentals:** Familiarity with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and how generative AI can be applied in a product context. Direct project experience preferred.

The base salary range for this US-based, full-time, and exempt position is $175,000-195,000/yr, not including variable compensation. An employee’s exact starting salary will be based on various factors including but not limited to experience, education, training, merit, location, and the ability to exemplify the HHAeXchange core values.

This is a benefits-eligible position. HHAeXchange offers competitive health plans, paid time-off, company paid holidays, 401K retirement program with a Company elected match, including other company sponsored programs.

HHAeXchange is an equal-opportunity employer. The Company offers employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, citizenship, genetic information, hairstyles, or any other status protected by local or federal law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

new_roles.description:
»

**Date:** Nov 12, 2026

**Location:** North Reading, MA, US

**Company:** Teradyne

We are the global test and automation specialists, powering next-generation technologies through sophisticated solutions. Behind every electronic device you use, Teradyne's test technology ensures your device works right the first time, every time! Our portfolio of automation solutions help manufacturers to develop and deliver products quickly, efficiently and cost-effectively. Together, Teradyne companies deliver manufacturing automation across industries and applications around the world!

 

We attract, develop, and retain a high-performance workforce, comprised of people with diverse backgrounds and a shared drive for excellence. We strive to foster a positive and inclusive work environment that helps employees, and communities, thrive.

**Our Purpose**

TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day.

We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.

 

**Opportunity Overview**

The Senior Director, Product Quality & Customer Excellence owns customer-perceived quality for Teradyne’s Compute Test Division, from design through the field. Reporting to the division’s VP of Engineering, this high-visibility role leads Software Quality Engineering and drives quality across hardware, software, FPGA, ASIC, applications, manufacturing, and service engineering. You will work with our executive team and largest customers to build the quality organization and reputation of the division.

* Lead customer escalations from first call to closure, driving Severity 1 and 2 escalations down 20 to 30% every year.
* Develop design reviews, risk analysis, and release gates that engineering respects and that stop a bad release.
* Collaborate with engineering leaders across organizations you do not manage, earning their commitment through credibility, data, and follow-through.
* Build trusted relationships with top customers, and cut field defect escapes every year while shipping every major launch clean through its first six months.
* Partner with leadership to show the cost of poor quality and the margin benefit of reducing it, and close more than 95% of corrective actions on time.
* Mentor and retain exceptional quality engineers, and develop the next generation of quality leaders.
 

**All About You**

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.

* BS in Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience (MS a plus)
* Typically 15+ years in quality, engineering, product development, or applications, including 10+ years leading cross-functional teams on complex technical products
* A measured, visible quality turnaround or product launch you can point to
* Strong command of product development, verification and validation, reliability, and field operations
* Proven success building and leading teams, including managers
* Direct experience working with executive-level customers
* Ability to take a big, ambiguous, high-stakes problem and drive it to done without waiting to be pushed
* Accountability for outcomes, not activity: you set targets publicly, then hit them or own the miss, and you tell the truth early
* A customer-first mindset, leading and influencing across organizations by earning commitment
* Preferred: experience in semiconductor test equipment (ATE), test and measurement, capital equipment, networking, or enterprise infrastructure
* Preferred: product quality leadership in mission critical, complex hardware and software systems
* Preferred: a track record of using AI, automation, and data to measurably speed up root-cause analysis and problem closure
 

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

You’ll know you’re succeeding when:

* Customer escalations fall every year, and the ones that happen close fast and stay closed.
* Launches ship clean and release gates hold.
* Engineering leaders bring you in early, not after the problem.
* Our top customers tell us we are getting better.
* You have built a quality team with a bench of leaders you developed.

**Apply** with the one result you are proudest of and the numbers that prove it.

 

If this role excites you but your background does not match every bullet above, we would still love to hear from you.

 

*We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position.*

*This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.*

 

**Compensation:**
 
The base salary range for this role is $228,200 - $365,100. This range is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with experience and skill set. This range can also fluctuate depending on demand and location.

**Incentive Plan:** This job is eligible for discretionary bonus(es) based on financial performance.

 

**Benefits:**
 
Teradyne offers a variety of robust health and well-being benefit programs, including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, and more.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies' core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

The Director of Quality, Defense is responsible for overseeing all quality activities, personnel, systems, and performance associated with Defense programs across multiple Karman Space & Defense operating sites. This role provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure all Defense hardware, assemblies, and services meet or exceed contractual, regulatory, and customer requirements. 
 
This position will manage the Defense Quality Engineering organization, supports execution of Defense programs, and ensures consistent application of quality standards and tools across the sector. This leader works in close partnership with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align each site's AS9100 compliant QMS with the emerging enterprise quality architecture and to transition multiple Defense sites toward a unified enterprise certification. 
 
This role is critical in driving disciplined execution, continuous improvement, product integrity, and customer satisfaction within the Defense market segment.

Reports to Vice President, Defense. Functional Partnership with Enterprise Director of Quality (Karman Space & Defense). 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 

* Lead, develop, and manage the Quality Engineering team supporting all Defense programs and projects.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement across Defense Quality functions.
* Serve as the primary Defense quality leader to the VP of Defense and the Defense leadership team.
* Ensure the quality of all Defense hardware, assemblies, engineered systems, and services produced across multiple sites.
* Oversee program quality planning, including inspection strategies, qualification/verification plans, critical characteristics control, product safety considerations, and risk mitigation.
* Review and approve quality requirements for Defense proposals, contracts, and manufacturing plans.
* Drive effective root cause analysis, corrective action, and failure review processes for Defense programs.
* Ensure each Defense site maintains compliance to AS9100, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Provide direct guidance to site Quality Managers/Quality Engineers on QMS implementation, audit readiness, and procedural improvement.
* Support site internal audits, customer audits, DCMA oversight, and third‑party certification audits.
* Partner with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align Defense site QMS structures, documentation, and practices with the enterprise quality framework.
* Support the long-term strategy to transition multiple Defense AS9100 certificates into a unified enterprise certificate.
* Collaborate closely on enterprise initiatives such as configuration management improvements, risk management systems, document control harmonization, supplier quality strategies, and enterprise metrics.

 
**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** 

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related technical field preferred
* 10 years of experience in aerospace/defense quality roles preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, and Defense customer quality standards.
* Quality Engineering experience with complex programs including design.

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS**

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, certain positions may require applicants to be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel 0-10% of the time.

Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

new_roles.title: VP Global Supply chain and manufacturing
new_roles.description:
At UVeye, we're on a mission to redefine vehicle safety and reliability on a global scale. Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world's first fully automated suite of AI-powered vehicle inspection systems, combining computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI.

With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, JLR, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is deployed across manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, fleets, and seaports worldwide. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies of 2026, our 270+ global employees are solutions-oriented, accountable, and driven by one shared goal: making roads safer for everyone.

We are seeking an experienced Vice President, Global Supply Chain to lead the strategy and execution of our end-to-end global supply chain, including procurement, strategic sourcing, supplier management, inventory planning, logistics, and warehouse operations. This executive will build scalable capabilities that support company growth, successful installations, and reliable field service across multiple geographies, with accountability for delivery performance, cost, working capital, and supply continuity.

This role requires a strategic, hands-on leader who can set long-term direction while working directly with teams and suppliers to negotiate critical agreements, resolve material constraints, and improve operational performance. Partnering closely with the COO and executive leadership team, the VP will align supply chain priorities with business objectives, strengthen planning and operational visibility, and develop a high-performing organization with clear ownership and measurable results.

A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:

* Set the global supply chain strategy. Develop and execute a multiyear roadmap aligned with growth plans, installation requirements, service commitments, and financial objectives.
* Own operational and financial performance. Establish accountability for total supply chain cost, inventory investment, delivery reliability, and warehouse productivity. Partner with Finance to develop budgets, evaluate investments, and deliver measurable improvements.
* Connect business demand with supply execution. Establish a cross-functional planning cadence that aligns forecasts, installation schedules, field service requirements, supplier capacity, and inventory availability. Surface constraints early and drive decisions that protect customer commitments.
* Lead strategic sourcing and supplier performance. Develop sourcing strategies, negotiate commercial agreements, and build supplier relationships that improve cost, quality, lead times, and capacity. Hold suppliers accountable through clear expectations and performance reviews.
* Build supply resilience. Identify critical dependencies and develop mitigation plans for supplier disruption, capacity constraints, long lead times, and cross-border risks.
* Optimize inventory and material availability. Establish inventory policies that balance installation and service readiness with working capital discipline, reducing shortages, excess stock, and obsolescence.
* Direct global logistics and warehouse operations. Design scalable distribution capabilities and oversee freight, import/export, fulfillment, and material flow to installation sites and field teams. Ensure safe, accurate, compliant, and efficient operations.
* Strengthen systems, data, and decision-making. Set standards for ERP data integrity, inventory visibility, and reporting. Prioritize improvements in systems and automation that support scale and better operational decisions.
* Build and develop the organization. Define the team structure, hire and develop strong leaders, establish succession plans, and create a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as an executive business partner. Present performance, risks, tradeoffs, and investment recommendations to senior leadership. Align stakeholders around decisions that improve customer outcomes and support sustainable growth.

 
Requirements:
 

* 15+ years of progressive supply chain experience, including at least 7 years in senior leadership roles overseeing multidisciplinary teams across multiple geographies. Demonstrated accountability for enterprise supply chain strategy, financial performance, and organizational development is required; prior VP-level or equivalent executive leadership experience is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
* A hands-on leadership approach, with the ability to set strategic direction while directly engaging in critical supplier negotiations, resolving material shortages, improving warehouse and logistics processes, and supporting installation and field service readiness.
* Experience leading complex supply chains across multiple geographies, including procurement, supplier management, inventory, logistics, and warehouse operations.
* A track record of scaling operations and delivering measurable improvements in cost, delivery performance, inventory efficiency, and supply reliability.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget ownership, working capital management, supplier negotiations, and investment evaluation.
* Experience establishing cross-functional planning processes that align demand, supply, and operational execution.
* Working knowledge of international trade, import/export compliance, and cross-border logistics.
* Experience using ERP systems and operational analytics to improve visibility, controls, and performance, with the ability to work directly with data to diagnose issues and drive corrective action; NetSuite experience is preferred.
* Ability to influence executive stakeholders, make decisions amid uncertainty, and translate strategy into clear priorities and accountable execution.
* Ability to develop strong leaders, delegate effectively, and build team capability while remaining actively engaged in operational performance.
* Ability to travel approximately 10–15% to support installation sites, operational locations, and supplier visits, including locations in Indiana, Canada, and Mexico.

Ideally, we’re looking for:

* VP / Director-level or equivalent leadership experience in a high-growth business with complex installation, deployment, or field service requirements.
* Experience supporting both project-based material demand and ongoing service or spare-parts needs.
* Success transforming a supply chain organization through direct involvement in process improvements, stronger planning, leadership development, and systems implementation.
* Experience expanding supplier and distribution capabilities into new geographies.
* A strategic, hands-on leader who is comfortable working alongside teams in warehouses, at installation sites, and with suppliers to understand challenges, remove barriers, and deliver results.

Benefits we offer:

* Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision.
* Company 401k Match.
* 20 PTO days, company-paid holidays.
* Career growth as we scale across the US.

Compensation:

UVeye provides salary ranges that comply with the New Jersey State Law on salary transparency in job advertisements. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, qualifications, skills, location, education, and operational needs. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentives or other forms of compensation or benefits. The annual base salary range for this position is $250,000 – $280,000.

Physical Requirements & Travel:

This role may involve on-site or field-based activities. Depending on the position, tasks may include extended periods of sitting, standing, or walking; working in and around vehicle service areas, rental facilities, dealerships, manufacturing sites, or warehouse environments; The role may also require travel, working in varying environmental conditions, and the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when appropriate. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

Why UVeye

 

* Tech-First Mindset: Join a team at the forefront of innovation, where cutting-edge technology is shaping the future of AI and redefining the automotive industry.
* Industry Leadership: Be part of a trailblazing company driving real change—backed by rapid growth, a track record of success, and strong partnerships with global industry leaders.
* People-Centered Culture: Thrive in a collaborative, inclusive environment that values initiative, supports growth, and provides unique opportunities for development through executive workshops and mentorship programs.

UVeye is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

new_roles.title: Vice President of Continuous Improvement & Lean
new_roles.description:
Eaton’s Electrical Sector America’s business is curretly hiring for a VP of Continuous Improvement & Lean. This role can be based at Eaton’s Cleveland or Pittsburgh office. Relocation within hiring country is offered. 50 percent travel is anticipated.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations, Electrical Sector – Americas (ESA), the VP of CI & Lean is the senior executive accountable for the vision, strategy, and results of the Eaton Continuous Improvement System (ECIS) across the $16B ESA business, spanning 60 manufacturing sites and 14 divisions. This role sets the multi-year Lean transformation agenda, builds continuous improvement into the sector's strategic and annual profit plans, and holds the business accountable for measurable improvement in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and growth.

The VP leads and develops the ESA CI team, defines the sector-wide operating model, standards, and governance the team deploys, and serves as a strategic advisor to the ESA leadership team. Rather than leading deployment within a division, this role directs CI resources to the highest-value opportunities, owns the sector's CI talent pipeline, and shapes a Lean leadership culture at the executive level. The VP also represents ESA in enterprise CI forums, partnering with Corporate CI & Quality to align standards and scale best practices across Eaton.

**Job Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Defines the multi-year ESA Lean and continuous improvement vision, strategy, and roadmap, and integrates it into the sector's strategic plan and annual profit plan.
* Owns the ECIS operating model for ESA: sets the standards, maturity expectations, and governance that the CI team deploys across divisions, functions, and sites.
* Leads, coaches, and develops the ESA CI team; sets objectives, allocates CI resources, and holds the team accountable for results.
* Chairs the Divisional CI Council across all ESA divisions and leads sector-level performance reviews, establishing the operating cadence that links CI results to business performance.
* Accountable for the ESA cost-out and productivity commitments delivered through CI; builds the sector project pipeline and validates financial impact.
* Serves as strategic advisor to the SVP of Operations and the ESA leadership team, prioritizing the transformation initiatives with the greatest business value.
* Sponsors large-scale, cross-divisional transformations (e.g., footprint changes, acquisition integrations, and Lean in office and transactional processes).
* Builds the sector CI talent strategy: capability standards, certification pathways (e.g., ASCEND X, PME), succession planning, and rotation of high-potential leaders through CI roles.
* Coaches ESA executives on Lean leadership behaviors and role-models a culture of accountability and continuous improvement from the top.
* Sets sector maturity targets and owns the EBSA and OpA assessment strategy; reviews results with leadership and directs closure of systemic gaps.
* Represents ESA in enterprise CI forums; partners with Corporate CI & Quality to shape Eaton-wide standards and scale proven practices across sectors.
* Manages the ESA CI function budget and champions digital and data analytics tools that accelerate improvement.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

Required Qualifications: 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Quality, or Operations

new_roles.title: Director of Operations - Chillers
new_roles.description:
Backed by more than a century of engineering excellence in thermal management technology, Modexus Solutions has sharpened its focus as a specialized leader in commercial HVAC and data center solutions into a new era. Throughout this evolution, our dynamic and collaborative culture, driven by our talented people, has propelled us to the forefront of the industry on a new frontier. At Modexus Solutions, we foster an environment of entrepreneurship and ingenuity, empowering our team to continually drive innovation. Joining Modexus Solutions means unlocking meaningful career growth, continuous development, and high-impact opportunities.

The answer is clear: your next opportunity starts here. Transform the future with us.

For more information about Modexus Solutions, visit www.modexussolutions.com

**Position Description**
------------------------

This role represents a critical executive leadership opportunity for a dynamic Director of Operations – Chillers to join the Global Operations team. Reporting directly to the VP of Global Operations with a dotted-line relationship to the Vice President & General Manager (VPGM) of the Chillers business unit, this leader has direct operational responsibility for all global chiller manufacturing plants.

Each global chiller facility holds full SQDC (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost) execution accountability. To drive self-sufficient, world-class execution at the plant level, the Director of Operations – Chillers will lead a comprehensive, multi-functional organization where each plant team includes dedicated Safety, Quality, Materials, and Manufacturing Operations resources.

As an integral member of the Global Operations team, this individual operates as an influential peer to Supply Chain (partnering to enable global Supply Chain and SIOP execution) and Materials (partnering to enable Materials management and Localized Procurement strategies), as well as the broader Global Operations leadership team. By bridging global functional capabilities with plant-level execution and business unit strategy, the Director of Operations – Chillers will drive rapid operational transformation, capacity expansion, and sustainable business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Global Plant Leadership & SQDC Execution Accountability**

* Hold direct operational oversight and P&L/conversion cost accountability for all global chiller manufacturing facilities.
* Drive rigorousSQDC (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost) daily management and execution across every chiller site:

* **Safety:** Champion a zero-injury culture, ensuring proactive EHS compliance, ergonomic improvements, and behavioral safety leadership across all plants.
* **Quality:** Ensure zero-defect manufacturing standards, robust quality management systems, customer compliance, and rapid root-cause corrective actions.
* **Delivery:** Achieve industry-leading on-time delivery (OTD) and lead-time competitiveness through effective line balancing, capacity tracking, and constraint management.
* **Cost:** Optimize direct and indirect labor productivity, overhead absorption, scrap reduction, and continuous conversion cost improvements.

### **2. Multi-Functional Team Management & Talent Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Plant Managers and site leadership teams across the global chiller footprint.
* Ensure each plant's respective organization is effectively structured and resourced across Safety, Quality, Materials, and Manufacturing Operations to deliver autonomous day-to-day SQDC execution.
* Build organizational capability, establish clear succession plans, and foster an empowered, high-accountability, results-oriented culture across both salaried and direct labor workforces.

**Job Responsibilities Continued**
----------------------------------

**3. Matrixed & Peer Collaboration**

* **Business Unit Alignment (Dotted Line to VPGM of Chillers):** Serve as a strategic operational partner to the VPGM of Chillers, translating commercial growth strategies, customer requirements, and new product introductions (NPI) into scalable manufacturing execution plans.
* **Supply Chain & SIOP Partnership (Peer to Supply Chain):** Collaborate closely with Supply Chain and the Supply Chain/SIOP organization to align long-term capacity planning, master production scheduling, demand-supply balancing, and headcount/capacity models.
* **Materials & Localized Procurement Partnership (Peer to Materials):** Partner closely with Materials and the Materials/Procurement organization to optimize plant-level material flow, inventory turns, working capital, supplier quality/delivery performance, and localized sourcing strategies.
* **Global Operations Synergy:** Collaborate with fellow peers on the Global Operations leadership team to standardize best practices, leverage shared subassembly/hub strategies, and drive enterprise-wide operational initiatives.

### **4. Operational Excellence, Footprint Strategy & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and execute the end-to-end global manufacturing strategy for the Chillers business, aligning footprint optimization, capital investments (CapEx), and automation roadmaps with long-term growth targets.
* Embed Lean manufacturing principles, 80/20 simplification, value-stream mapping, and continuous improvement methodologies across all global chiller sites.
* Support modular design integration, subassembly standardization, and agile manufacturing practices in partnership with Advanced Manufacturing Engineering and Design Engineering.

**Required Education & Qualifications**
---------------------------------------

* **Bachelor’s degree** in Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related technical discipline is required.
* **10+ years** of progressive experience in manufacturing and operations leadership roles (e.g., Plant Manager, Senior Operations Manager, Director of Operations) within complex, engineered-to-order or configure-to-order industrial/HVAC manufacturing environments.
* **5+ years** of proven experience leading multi-site / global manufacturing operations, demonstrating measurable improvements in SQDC metrics.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional plant organizations encompassing Safety, Quality, Materials, and Manufacturing Operations.
* Deep functional knowledge of Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, 80/20 principles, Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SIOP), material replenishment systems, and localized procurement interfaces.
* Proven ability to thrive in a matrixed organizational structure, effectively balancing solid-line functional excellence (to the VP, Global Operations) with dotted-line commercial business unit alignment (to the VPGM of Chillers).
* Exceptional executive presence, communication, and interpersonal influencing skills, with a collaborative approach to working with peer leaders across Supply Chain, Materials, Engineering, and Finance.
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally (up to 30%–50% depending on home base location) to support global chiller manufacturing plants.

**Why Choose Modexus Solutions?**

**Health & Well-being:**

* Competitive Health, Dental & Vision Insurance Coverage **on Day One!**
* Additional Benefits After 90 days of Continuous Employment
 + 8 weeks of short term disability leave paid at 100%
 + 4 weeks of paid parental leave paid at 100%
 + Maternity Leave (12 weeks at 100% pay)
 + Paternity Leave (4 weeks at 100% pay)

**Financial Benefits:**

* 401k Retirement plan and company match
* Life Insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Short Term Disability (company paid)
* Long Term Disability

new_roles.title: Head of Quality
new_roles.description:
**About Bora:**

Bora Biologics is a global biologics CDMO delivering integrated development and GMP manufacturing solutions from First‑in‑Human through licensed commercial supply. While many CDMOs are structured primarily for early clinical programs, Bora Biologics is purpose‑built for commercialization. Our inspection‑proven, bi‑coastal U.S. manufacturing platform and integrated development center provide the infrastructure, regulatory discipline, and operational precision required for sustained global market supply.

**Summary**

Reporting to the VP, Regional Head of Quality, the BBUL Site Head of Quality is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing a comprehensive Quality Management strategy aligned with corporate policies, client expectations, and global regulatory requirements. This role ensures products from development through commercialization are safe, effective, and fully compliant with applicable CGMP/GxP standards. As a key member of the site leadership team, the Director/Sr. Director of Quality provides strategic and operational leadership for the Quality organization, which includes Quality Assurance and Quality Control. The role partners cross-functionally with all departments to foster a strong culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement while ensuring regulatory compliance and client satisfaction. The Director/Sr. Director also directs day-to-day quality operations, drives operational excellence and process optimization, supports execution of strategic and tactical initiatives, and ensures timely resolution of quality and compliance issues to maintain business performance and inspection readiness.

 

**Essential Functions**

*Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* P rovide strategic leadership and overall accountability for the site Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with global policies, procedures, CGMP/GxP standards, and applicable regulatory requirements across the U.S. and international markets including EU.
* Partner with the Site Leadership Team (SLT) to strengthen and sustain a proactive culture of quality, escalating significant compliance risks and driving timely, effective resolution of quality issues.
* Lead and oversee regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring inspection readiness, effective agency interactions, and timely, compliant responses to observations.
* Direct all core Quality functions, including batch record review, material and product disposition, deviations and change control, document control, QC, QA oversight of all GMP functions including validation, operations, and facility activities.
* Provide leadership to ensure uninterrupted support for successful product transfers through robust quality oversight and operational excellence.
* Serve as the senior Quality leader supporting development initiatives and phased clinical programs, ensuring appropriate compliance throughout product development activities.
* Lead the Quality organization in achieving operational and strategic objectives, including budget planning and management, workforce planning, project execution, and organizational effectiveness.
* Establish and monitor key quality metrics (e.g., deviations, CAPAs, change controls, product release) to foster accountability. Evaluate system effectiveness and drive corrective action.
* Oversee quality indicators and operational efficiencies, implementing action plans to mitigate risks and streamline quality processes.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing Quality organization that operates as a trusted, collaborative business partner, while driving talent development, succession planning, and employee growth.
* Establish clear, consistent, and effective communication across the Quality organization and with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, risks, and business objectives.
Perform additional responsibilities and strategic initiatives as assigned 

*The above statements are intended to describe the nature of work performed by those in this job and are not an exhaustive list of all duties. Nothing in this job description restricts managements right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time which reflects management’s assignment of essential functions.*

**Minimum Education, Experience and Skills**

new_roles.title: Director, MSAT/External Manufacturing Management
new_roles.description:
OPPORTUNITY

Mammoth Biosciences is seeking a Director, Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) to lead the scale-up of our lipid nanoparticle (LNP) drug product process from Phase 1 into Phase 2 and toward late stage readiness. This leader will own the technical path from the current clinical process to a well-characterized, scalable process that is ready for process performance qualification (PPQ).

All manufacturing and analytical work is performed at external contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) and contract testing labs. The Director will be Mammoth's technical owner of the process at those partners, ensuring that development, technology transfer, process characterization and PPQ are executed in line with current regulatory guidance and industry best practice.

This is a build role. Initially the Director will deliver through external resources (CDMOs, consultants and contract staff), then grow an internal MSAT team in stages as program milestones are met. The role reports to the Head of CMC and works closely with Process Development, Analytical Development, Quality, Regulatory CMC, Supply Chain and Program Management.

### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Process scale-up and technology transfer

* Lead scale-up of the Phase 1 LNP process (nucleic acid payload formulation, mixing, buffer exchange/TFF, sterile filtration and fill) to Phase 2 and late-stage clinical scale
* Define the scale-up strategy, including equipment selection, mixing platform scalability, scale-down model development and comparability between process versions
* Plan and execute technology transfers of processes and methods between Mammoth, development partners and GMP CDMOs, including transfer protocols, gap assessments and engineering runs
* Own the technical risk assessments (e.g., FMEA) that drive scale-up and characterization priorities

Process characterization and PPQ readiness

* Build the control strategy using a QbD approach: define CQAs and CPPs, link material attributes to product quality, and set proven acceptable ranges
* Design and oversee process characterization studies (DoE, qualified scale-down models, hold times, mixing and filtration studies) that support the control strategy and regulatory filings
* Lead PPQ planning and execution: validation master plan inputs, PPQ protocols and reports, acceptance criteria, sampling plans and the transition to continued process verification
* Partner with Analytical Development to make sure methods are phase-appropriate, validated on time and fit to support characterization and PPQ

External manufacturing and CDMO management

* Serve as Mammoth's technical lead and person-in-plant at CDMOs and contract labs for development, engineering and GMP campaigns
* Lead selection, qualification and oversight of CDMO partners for drug product manufacturing, fill-finish operations and drug product testing, including technical due diligence, capacity and capability assessment, and scale-up fit
* Provide technical oversight for engineering and GMP runs at external partners
* Develop scalable, phase-appropriate aseptic drug product processes at CDMOs, including fill-finish operations, cryogenic handling (as applicable) and cold-chain compatibility
* Assess and implement suitable container-closure systems (vials, syringes) that meet regulatory and operational requirements
* Accountable for review and approval of batch records in accordance with regulatory guidelines; review campaign plans, deviations, investigations, CAPAs and change controls in partnership with Quality
* Manage partner timelines, budgets, deliverables and quality in collaboration with internal stakeholders; drive technical decisions and escalate issues early
* Project manage external stakeholders and high-profile partner meetings (up to 10% of time)
* Contribute to technical sections of quality agreements, statements of work and budgets

Regulatory and cross-functional support

* Author and review CMC sections for IND/IMPD/CTA amendments, end-of-Phase 2 and later filings (Module 3 process description, process development history, process validation)
* Support regulatory interactions and inspections with process knowledge and data
* Provide manufacturing input to program plans, timelines and supply forecasts

Team and resource leadership

* In the early phase, deliver through external resources: CDMO technical teams, consultants and contract MSAT staff
* Build the internal MSAT function in stages tied to milestones, including hiring plans, roles and the balance of internal and outsourced work
* Set up MSAT systems and practices: tech transfer templates, process knowledge management, data trending and lifecycle documentation

### **REEQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* PhD in chemical engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or a related field with 10+ years of industry experience, or MS with 14+ or BS with 16+ years of experience
* 6+ years in MSAT, process development or technical operations for parenteral drug products, including at least 3 years in a leadership role
* Hands-on experience scaling up LNP or comparable complex parenteral processes (liposomes, nanoparticles, nucleic acid formulations) from early clinical to late-stage scale
* Led at least one process characterization and PPQ campaign through completion, with working command of ICH Q8–Q12 and FDA/EMA process validation expectations
* Extensive experience managing CDMOs and contract labs as the sponsor's technical lead, including tech transfer, person-in-plant oversight, deviations and change control
* Experience with fill-finish operations, aseptic processing and external manufacturing oversight
* Strong working knowledge of cryogenic storage and cold-chain management for LNP drug products
* Track record of authoring CMC regulatory sections and supporting agency interactions
* Ability to influence and direct external partners without line authority, and to make sound technical calls under timeline pressure
* Ability for frequent domestic and international travel to CDMO and contract lab sites, estimated at up to [30–40]% and peaking during engineering, characterization and PPQ campaigns
* Must be able to travel internationally on short notice and hold, or be able to obtain, a valid passport and any visas needed for partner sites
* Ability to commit to extended on-site presence at CDMOs (person-in-plant) during critical campaigns, sometimes across time zones.
* Based in the San Francisco Bay Area preferred, with ability to work onsite at our Brisbane, CA location; hybrid or remote arrangements are available
* Ability to work Pacific Time Zone hours if not located on the West Coast
* Ability to travel to Mammoth’s Brisbane, CA HQ regularly if not local

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Direct experience with mRNA/LNP or gene editing drug products
* Experience with impingement jet or microfluidic mixing scale-up, TFF and sterile filtration of LNPs
* Experience with commercial process validation and BLA/MAA preparation
* Experience building a function or team from the ground up in a small or mid-size biotech
* Working knowledge of statistical tools for DoE and process data analysis (e.g., JMP, Minitab)

### **BENEFITS**

* Company-paid health/vision/dental benefits
* Unlimited vacation and generous sick time
* Company-sponsored meals and snacks
* Wellness, caregiver and ergonomics benefits
* 401(k) with company matching

Actual base salary will be determined by relevant professional experience, applicable skills, and internal equity

**COMPANY**

Mammoth Biosciences is a biotechnology company focused on leveraging its proprietary ultracompact CRISPR systems to develop long-term curative therapies, as well as other applications such as decentralized precision diagnostics. Founded by CRISPR pioneer and Nobel laureate Jennifer Doudna and Trevor Martin, Janice Chen, and Lucas Harrington, the company’s ultracompact proteins are designed to enable *in vivo* gene editing in difficult to reach tissues utilizing both nuclease applications and new editing modalities beyond double stranded breaks, including base editing, gene writing, and epigenetic editing. The company is building out its pipeline of potential *in vivo* gene editing therapeutics and capabilities and has partnerships with leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to broaden the reach of its innovative and proprietary technology. Mammoth’s deep science and industry experience, along with a robust and differentiated intellectual property portfolio, have enabled the company to further its mission to transform the lives of patients and deliver on the full promise of CRISPR technologies.

It is our policy and intent to provide equal opportunity to all persons without regard to race, color, religion, political affiliation, sex/gender (including gender expression/identity, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, age, ancestry, national origin, veteran status, disability, medical condition, genetic characteristics, and/or any other basis protected by law. This policy covers all facets of employment including, but not limited to: recruitment, selection, placement, promotions, transfers, demotions, terminations, training, and compensation.

*Mammoth Biosciences requires that all employees be vaccinated against COVID as a condition of at-will employment, with exceptions for medical or religious reasons in compliance with local, state, and federal law.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

new_roles.title: Sr. Director, Quality Operations
new_roles.description:
**The Asahi Kasei Group operates with a commitment of creating for tomorrow. Our business sectors,** ***Materials, Homes, and Health Care*** **, contribute to the development of society by anticipating the changing needs of those around the world. We look for candidates that offer a fresh perspective and a variety of skills to help us achieve our commitment.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 
 
Asahi Kasei Therapeutics is the global specialty pharmaceutical business of Asahi Kasei. We are a commercial-stage company committed to positively impacting health by expanding therapeutic options that improve the lives of patients around the world. Drawing upon our strong heritage of scientific innovation, we aim to help reshape care in transplantation, nephrology, immunology, infectious diseases and other underserved conditions. 
 

**Job Description:**

 

The Senior Director of Quality Operations is a strategic and hands‑on leader responsible for ensuring the quality and compliance of all GMP/GDP activities executed internally and by external partners for the company’s products, supporting both clinical trials and commercial distribution, working with the VP of QA, QC and AD

 

This role provides oversight across CDMOs and testing labs, ensuring timely product disposition, investigation management, and quality support throughout the product lifecycle.

 

The base compensation range for this role is $230-260K. Base Compensation is influenced by many factors including, but not limited to: time in the role, previous experience, skills, knowledge, performance, work requirements, internal equity, and business / economic conditions.

 

The Senior Director QA Operations is accountable and responsible to:

* Ensure that the company's global Quality Management System (QMS), processes, and procedures required in the development, manufacture, supply and distribution and related activities are established, maintained and continuously improved in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, including but not necessarily limited to GMP and GDP.
* Provide global and independent Quality Management support, and in particular GMP and GDP oversight, leadership, expertise, reviews and as required quality approvals.
* Assure a satisfactory state of control and compliance with the AKTX QMS, and applicable GMP and GDP standards, authorizations, internal policies, procedures and protocols related to product for clinical trials and commercial manufacturing,
* Actively identify and communicate compliance issues or risks, develop and oversee plans to rectify issues or mitigate risks.

The Senior QA Director works in close collaboration with AKTX functional heads and process owners leading the development, supply and distribution of AKTX medicinal products.

 

**Tasks and responsibilities/accountabilities**

* Take an active role in development and delivery of AKTX strategy, objectives and targets.
* Support development of the QA unit and its way of working, budget, and deliverables in accordance with agreed corporate and individual objectives.
* Lead QA Operations and provide strategic leadership to QA operations staff by driving development, performance, coaching initiatives and ensuring optimal resource allocation to achieve organizational goals and deliver on targets, and objectives
* Collaborate within QA and with process owners, management and departments to establish, maintain and continually improve a fit-for-purpose, robust and effective global QMS.
* Act as owner of assigned business and quality management processes within the QMS and drive and ensure their suitability and effectiveness, and continual improvements.
* Provide oversight across CDMOs and service providers for clinical and commercial programs, ensuring timely product disposition, investigation management, and quality support throughout the product lifecycle.
* Serve as the quality lead in cross-functional CMC teams, partnering with MTO, QC/AD, Regulatory, Clinical, PAM and Supply Chain to ensure end-to-end GMP compliance
* Represent QA in governance and escalation forums for manufacturing investigations, supplier issues, or product quality events
* Own and continuously improve core quality systems including batch release, deviation/CAPA and change control and ensure scalability.
* Provide Quality Oversight, and support of:

new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**Plant Director**

 

**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

**This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role** 
As a **Plant Director**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

 

* Leading a team of employees dedicated to making what is indispensable to empower modern life, advance human progress, and deliver a brighter future through 3M Science.
* Overseeing plant environment, health, safety, regulatory and security practices that respect our environment, meet requirements established by regulatory bodies, protect our employees, and align with company expectations.
* Leading operational excellence through conscientious management and decisive actions in environment, health, safety, quality, manufacturing, supply chain, cost, and employee relations.
* Utilizing operational financial acumen to analyze and understand the financial implications of various choices and actions, making informed decisions based on financial data to maximize profits and minimize losses.
* Understanding and applying technology platform fundamentals and principles, thinking strategically, and identifying opportunities to leverage technology for business growth and operational efficiency.
* Accelerating value creation for our customers through responsive end-to-end supply chain performance and prompt resolution to customer inquiries.
* Developing strategic plans and budgets to drive continuous and sustainable improvements through the application of disruptive technology, lean six sigma methods, and effective employee engagement programs.
* Managing inventory, and influencing supplier performance.
* Championing inclusive programs that create a great place to work for all our employees and demonstrating behavior aligned with a work environment in which employees, consultants, and contract workers know that ethical and legal behavior is always expected of them.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited institution.
* Ten (10) years of experience in a manufacturing or production facility in private, public, government, or military environment.
* Five (5) years of experience in a plant leadership role.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Proven experience in plant leadership roles, demonstrating the ability to drive operational excellence and achieve results.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, quality control, and safety standards.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate teams.
* Demonstrated ability to anticipate future trends, effectively prepare for change, create and communicate change action plans, and implement sustainable change.
* Strategic mindset and the ability to develop and execute plans to meet operational goals.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in physical sciences, Operations Management, or a related field (advanced degree preferred).
* Experience in proven continuous improvement process improvement methodologies.

**Work location:**

* **Onsite, Tonawanda, New York**

**Travel: May include up to 10%** **domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

**Chat with Max**

For assistance with searching through our current job openings or for more information about all things 3M, visit Max, our virtual recruiting assistant on 3M.com/careers.

This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant knowledge, training, skills, work location, and/or experience. new_roles.description:
**Position:** Director – Operations 
**Location:** North Carolina/ South Carolina 
**Type:** Full-Time 
**Reports To:** CEO, ZetSol Energy

**Who We Are**

ZetSol Energy is the solar manufacturing and supply chain platform built to give North American solar developers, EPCs, utilities, and independent power producers a reliable, tariff-compliant alternative to fragmented overseas sourcing. The company is establishing a vertically integrated greenfield facility in Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu, producing silicon ingots, monocrystalline wafers, cells, and modules, including high-efficiency TOPCon and HJT technology, and pairs that manufacturing base with a full strategic sourcing, bill-of-materials management, quality audit, compliance, and logistics practice purpose-built for the US market.

ZetSol Energy is backed by Zetwerk, a global manufacturing platform valued at over $2.7 billion that already supplies solar piles, mechanical and structural components, and modules to leading US EPCs and asset owners, and whose 2022 acquisition of Unimacts strengthened its US industrial and solar manufacturing footprint. ZetSol Energy is the next chapter of that build-out: a dedicated US-facing commercial platform launching at a moment when American solar developers are actively searching for supply chain partners who can deliver both scale and certainty.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced operations leader to lead and scale ZetSol Energy's US operations, with overall responsibility for manufacturing, factory production, supply chain, logistics and sales operations.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing large-scale operations, with a strong background in Supply Chain Management (SCM), logistics and manufacturing, preferably within the renewable energy, solar or industrial sectors.

This individual will be responsible for overseeing factory production, managing end-to-end supply chain and logistics operations, and driving sales operations, including demand planning, order management and customer fulfilment in the US market.

The role will also involve building strong relationships with US government authorities, regulatory bodies, logistics partners and other key industry stakeholders, while ensuring operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and cost optimisation.

This is a key leadership position that will play an instrumental role in building and scaling ZetSol Energy's US operations, establishing robust operational processes and driving business growth in North America.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee end-to-end US operations for ZetSol Energy, covering manufacturing, supply chain, logistics and sales operations.

* Manage factory production operations, including production planning, capacity utilisation, quality, productivity and timely delivery.

* Drive end-to-end supply chain and logistics operations, including global sourcing, procurement, inventory management, import/export, customs clearance and distribution.

* Oversee sales operations, including demand planning, order management, customer fulfilment and coordination with commercial teams.

* Build and manage relationships with US government authorities, regulatory bodies, customs officials, port authorities, logistics partners and other key stakeholders.

* Ensure compliance with US trade regulations, import policies, tariffs and applicable industry standards while driving operational efficiency and cost optimisation.

* Build and scale the US operations team, processes and infrastructure while working closely with the leadership and manufacturing teams in India.

**Qualifications**

* 15–20 years of experience in operations, manufacturing, supply chain management and logistics, preferably within renewable energy, solar, infrastructure or industrial sectors.

* Extensive experience managing large-scale manufacturing operations, including factory production, production planning, quality and operational efficiency.

* Strong experience in end-to-end supply chain, logistics and sales operations, including global sourcing, procurement, import/export, order management and customer fulfilment.

* Strong understanding of US trade regulations, import compliance, tariffs, customs procedures and logistics frameworks.

* Established relationships with government authorities, regulatory bodies, customs officials, port authorities and key industry stakeholders.

* Proven track record of building and managing large operational teams, vendor ecosystems and strategic partnerships, with strong commercial and cost management capabilities.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in the solar, renewable energy or energy manufacturing ecosystem.

* Previous experience leading operations for a global manufacturing or industrial organisation.

* Experience managing manufacturing facilities and cross-border operations between the US and international markets, preferably India.

* Ability to build and scale operational infrastructure in a fast-growing business environment.

**Why ZetSol Energy**

* Opportunity to play a key leadership role in building ZetSol Energy's US operations.

* Work closely with the CEO and leadership team in shaping the company's operational strategy.

* Opportunity to build and scale a large operational and supply chain ecosystem.

* Be part of a growing solar manufacturing and supply chain platform backed by Zetwerk's global manufacturing capabilities.

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person

new_roles.title: Senior Director, CMC-Lead and Product Stewardship, Global Technical Operations
new_roles.description:
**Location** Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States **Job ID** R-264447 **Date posted** 16/11/2026

 

**Introduction**

As Senior Director, CMC Product Lead and Head of Product Stewardship, you will lead end-to-end CMC product strategy and the Product Stewardship and Product Champion organization within Global Technical Operations (GTO).

You will lead sophisticated Global CMC programs across development, PPQ, commercialization, and lifecycle management while shaping Product Stewardship capabilities, governance, processes, and talent.

You will guide strategy, manage risk, and drive cross-functional decisions that support product progression and commercial supply.

**What you'll do**

You will lead global CMC operations groups for sophisticated biologics and other advanced modalities across development, PPQ, market rollout, and end-to-end product stewardship. You will define and deliver Global CMC strategies across manufacturing science and technology, manufacturing, analytical, quality, regulatory, technical transfer, and supply activities.

You will lead all aspects of the responsibilities related to Product Stewardship and the role of Product Champion, improving technical and CMC leadership throughout the product lifecycle. Working with BPD, Cross-SET, eGPT, GPT, and Operations teams, you will shape product strategy, influence decisions, and resolve cross-functional issues. Ensure products and processes are scalable, robust, transferable, and ready for commercialization and lifecycle management.

You will advance Early Engagement and drive CoGS strategy, identifying risks early and incorporating yield, process efficiency, manufacturability, network fit, and supply resilience into product decisions. You will also strengthen post-launch CMC leadership across product quality, supply, lifecycle improvements, and post-approval submissions.

You will establish effective governance, decision rights, escalation pathways, role clarity, and ways of working. You will lead all aspects of sophisticated product, technical, quality, supply, and CMC issues and represent Operations, Biologics, and GTO in senior governance discussions.

You will champion data-driven decision-making and the practical use of digital tools, sophisticated analytics, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities. You will build organizational strength through talent development, succession planning, and an inclusive, high-performing culture.

**Essential requirements**

* Degree in a relevant scientific or engineering field.
* 15+ years of leadership experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, with deep expertise in biologics, CMC, technical operations, commercialization, product stewardship, or related fields.
* Experience leading sophisticated Global CMC programs, Operations Global CMC teams, major biologics products, or comparable cross-functional technical programs.
* Strong understanding of late-stage development, scale-up, technology transfer, process validation and PPQ, commercialization, control strategy, comparability, lifecycle management, and post-approval change.
* Proven track record to align cross-functional teams within a global matrix.
* Experience leading senior technical teams and building organizational capability through talent development and succession planning.
* Strong enterprise and matrix leadership, with the credibility to influence decisions in senior governance forums.
* Excellent communication and judgment, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly and connect technical decisions with product and business outcomes.

**Desirable requirements**

* Advanced degree in a relevant scientific or engineering field.
* Experience leading Product Stewardship, Product Champion, technical product leadership, or similar product-facing organizations.
* Experience across development and commercial manufacturing networks, including internal and external supply.
* Experience with Global CMC governance, regulatory submissions, post-approval changes, and lifecycle management for biologics or complex modalities.
* Experience advancing digital transformation, analytics, automation, or AI-enabled capabilities within CMC, MSAT, Product Stewardship, or manufacturing operations.
* Experience crafting or improving cross-functional processes, frameworks for authority and accountability, and operating models in a global organization.

**Why AstraZeneca?**

At AstraZeneca, we 're dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and spark your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

*The annual base pay for this position ranges from $216,996.00-$325,494.00*

*Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short-term incentive bonuses, equity-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.*

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
The Director of Operations leads all day-to-day operations at Innova's M3 facility in Mexicali, Mexico, including production, maintenance, purchasing, shipping and receiving, and site safety. Working closely with the site leadership team, this role ensures production goals, quality standards, cost targets, and customer delivery commitments are met. The Director builds and develops a strong local team, drives continuous improvement, and serves as the key link between the Mexicali plant and Innova's U.S. leadership, Finance, Quality, and Sales teams. The ideal candidate is based in the San Diego area, is fully bilingual in English and Spanish, and has proven experience leading manufacturing operations in Mexico.

 

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Champion and uphold the company's values, mission, and quality policy in all activities.

* Adhere to and help enforce company policies, procedures, and internal control standards.

* Ensure compliance with all applicable Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, including ISO 9001 and ISO 13485, as applicable to this role.

* Follow all safety rules and PPE requirements, and promptly report hazards, incidents, and near-misses.

* Lead all operations at the M3 facility, including production, maintenance, purchasing, and shipping and receiving, to meet production goals, quality standards, and customer delivery commitments.

* Direct and develop the site leadership team, including hiring, training, performance management, and succession planning.

* Oversee production planning and scheduling to balance capacity, labor, and materials with customer demand.

* Establish operational KPIs and monitor productivity, efficiency, scrap, cost, and on-time delivery, taking corrective action as needed.

* Oversee the site safety program and ensure compliance with applicable Mexican health, safety, and environmental regulations (e.g., STPS and NOM standards), fostering a strong culture of safety.

* Develop and manage the site operating budget, labor plan, and capital expenditure requests.

* Oversee equipment maintenance and facility upkeep to maximize uptime and maintain a safe, organized plant.

* Drive lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives to reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower costs.

* Coordinate with logistics and customs partners to support cross-border shipments, materials flow, and import/export requirements.

* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, employee relations, and compliance with Mexican labor law.

* Serve as the primary liaison between the Mexicali plant and Innova's U.S. leadership, Quality, Finance, and Sales, providing regular operational and financial reporting.

* Perform other related duties as required.

 

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree in Operations Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations, including at least 5 years in a leadership role, required.

* Experience leading manufacturing operations in Mexico (maquiladora or similar cross-border environment) strongly preferred.

* Experience with plastics manufacturing processes (e.g., injection molding, thermoforming, CNC machining) preferred.

* Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma certification preferred.

 

**SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* Fully bilingual in English and Spanish (written and verbal) required.

* Proven leadership skills, with the ability to build, motivate, and develop a high-performing team.

* Extensive knowledge of manufacturing operations, production planning, and plant management.

* Strong working knowledge of lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.

* Financial acumen, with the ability to develop budgets, manage costs, and interpret financial data.

* Working knowledge of Mexican labor, safety, and environmental regulations.

* Working knowledge of quality system requirements under ISO 9001 and ISO 13485, as applicable to this role.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and ERP/MRP systems.

* Valid passport and ability to cross the U.S.–Mexico border regularly.

 

**TRAINING & COMPETENCY REQUIREMENTS**

* Complete new-hire orientation and role-specific on-the-job training prior to performing unsupervised work.

* Complete Quality Management System (QMS) training applicable to this role, including quality policy awareness and the consequences of nonconformance to product or process requirements.

* Complete safety training applicable to this role (e.g., PPE use, lockout/tagout, forklift certification).

* Maintain competency through periodic refresher or retraining as required by department procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.

 

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Office setting.

* Manufacturing floor environment.

* Use of personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses.

 

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

* Mobility to navigate the production floor to conduct inspections and oversight.

 

**EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK**

* This is a full-time exempt position, required to work Monday through Friday. Occasional weekend availability may be required based on business needs.

 

**TRAVEL**

* Regular cross-border travel between San Diego, CA and the M3 facility in Mexicali, with on-site presence required a minimum of 4 days per week.

* Occasional travel to other Innova facilities, customers, and suppliers, up to 10%.
