new_roles.title: Director of Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Company Overview:**

Adams Communication & Engineering Technology (ACET), Incorporated is a Veteran Owned Small Business (VOSB) system engineering and information technology firm. Incorporated in 1999, we support mission critical Information Technology (IT) business needs for clients within the intelligence community (IC), Department of Defense (DOD), Veteran Administration (VA) and for select commercial clients. ACET, Inc.’s technical, programmatic, and analytical professionals are experts in commercial technology, customized solutions, and proprietary government systems.

**The Position:**

ACET is seeking an experienced, results-driven **Director of Manufacturing** to lead all production, fabrication, assembly, and shop-floor operations at our **Havelock, NC** facility. Reporting directly to executive leadership, the Director of Manufacturing will oversee day-to-day plant performance, drive operational excellence, ensure strict adherence to DoD quality and safety standards, and partner closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management to deliver defense projects on time and within budget.

**Responsibilities:**

* Direct all daily manufacturing, machining, fabrication, and assembly operations in Havelock to meet customer delivery schedules, cost targets, and quality specifications.
* Partner with Program Managers and Engineering teams to transition designs from rapid prototyping and Engineering Manufacturing Development (EMD) into Low-Rate Initial Production (LRIP) and full-rate sustainment.
* Enforce compliance with ISO 9001, AS9100, and Department of Defense manufacturing standards, ensuring zero-defect delivery and full audit readiness.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related technical field (or equivalent military/industry leadership experience).
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 3–5 years in a Plant Manager, Manufacturing Manager, or Director-level role within the aerospace, defense, or government contracting sector.
* Proven expertise in precision machining, sheet metal fabrication, electro-mechanical assembly, ERP/MRP systems, and reading complex engineering drawings/blueprints.
* Hands-on experience operating under ISO 9001 and/or AS9100 quality management systems.
* U.S. Citizenship required; must hold an active DoD Secret security clearance (or have the ability to obtain and maintain one).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience supporting NAVAIR, Fleet Readiness Center East (FRC East), or USMC/DoD aviation sustainment programs.
* Certification in Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt).
* Experience managing manufacturing operations within a small-to-midsize defense contractor environment, including familiarity with FAR/DFARS compliance and government-furnished property (GFP).

**Why Join ACET:**

ACET continues to expand its aerospace and aviation sustainment operations supporting multiple Department of Defense aviation platforms worldwide. This position provides the opportunity to directly shape strategic sustainment growth initiatives while supporting operational readiness and mission success across the global aviation enterprise.

At ACET, we believe that our employees are our most valuable asset. We are committed to providing a comprehensive Total Rewards program that recognizes and supports the diverse needs of our workforce. **\*\*Must be US Citizen to apply\*\***

new_roles.title: Director, Instrument Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

The primary purpose of this position is to plan and direct departmental functions (Instrument Manufacturing, Engineering, Instrument Refurbishing) at the St. Louis Operations site to ensure achievement of the corporate goals and objectives of the worldwide bioMerieux organization. This position is responsible for the manufacture and maintenance of instrument production and refurbishment through oversight of multiple teams. In addition, this position: provides technical expertise and quality support through implementation of projects and continuous improvement activities; identifies and justifies projects for capital funding, and deliver the projects on time and budget. Also requires coordinating and overseeing the implementation of engineering projects related to cost improvements and new product introductions, ensuring cooperation within and outside the department at both the local and global levels. And finally, responsible for developing and maintaining an engaged, motivated and skilled production work force.

**Primary Duties**
==================

* Manage Manufacturing – Manage the manufacturing and refurbishment groups to ensure customer satisfaction. Deliver the forecasted product on schedule with no errors or nonconformities. Maintain the complex manufacturing process and minimize loss. Maintain high employee morale, drive cooperation between departments at both local and global levels, and drive employee career development.
* Manage and Maintain Production Equipment – Ensure that the manufacturing areas are maintained so that production can continuously manufacture and refurbish product. End result: Successfully manufacturer product to meet demand and improve efficiency to reduce the COGS.
* Product Transfer – Manage the transfer of new products from Research to Manufacturing. Validate the new processes to meet regulatory requirements and ensure the necessary procedures are in place to order parts / materials to meet market demand. End result: Successful market introduction of new, high quality products that meet all relevant and applicable regulatory requirements.
* CAPA Investigations – Manage and provide technical expertise to projects related to investigating failures in current product production or testing processes.
* Cost Improvement and Risk Management – Manage and provide technical expertise to justify and implement cost improvement projects in Operations.
* Finance – Ensure adherence to Departmental budgets.
* Personnel – hiring, maintenance, organization, engagement, and performance of qualified manufacturing, engineering, and other personnel.
* Perform all work in compliance with company quality procedures and standards.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Bachelor’s degree required– Engineering, Supply Chain Management, R&D, Business, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience leading manufacturing operations, with budget oversight and demonstrated experience in cost reduction and operational efficiency.
* 3+ years experience managing operations in an ISO 13485 regulated manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading transformational change.
* Demonstrated experience in talent management and succession planning.
* Experience with capacity, automation, capital investments preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
====================================

* Consistently upholds and reflects the core ethical principles and values that bioMérieux promotes.
* Comfortable giving clear, direct, and actionable feedback.
* Driving continuous improvement by evaluating processes and implementing necessary changes.
* Inspire and energize individuals to achieve their best performance.
* Drive for Results while successfully removing barriers.
* Communicates instructions clearly and effectively.
* Advanced Microsoft Suite Skills: demonstrates deep knowledge; manages complex tasks and integrates multiple tools independently.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
================================

* Direct supervision of approximately 1–5 employees.
* Indirect supervision of approximately 100+ employees.
* Required to make financial, manufacturing process, organizational changes, product and team development decisions.

**Working Conditions**
======================

* Domestic travel required: 10% of time
* International travel required: 5% of time
* Total travel: 15%

The estimated salary range for this role is between $155,000-$198,000. This role is eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and individual performance per bioMérieux’s bonus program. This range may differ from ranges offered for similar positions elsewhere in the country given differences in cost of living. Actual compensation within this range is determined based on the successful candidate’s experience and will be presented in writing at the time of the offer.

In addition, bioMérieux offers a competitive Total Rewards package that may include:

* A choice of medical (including prescription), dental, and vision plans providing nationwide coverage and telemedicine options

* Company-Provided Life and Accidental Death Insurance

* Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance

* Retirement Plan including a generous non-discretionary employer contribution and employer match.

* Adoption Assistance

* Wellness Programs

* Employee Assistance Program

* Commuter Benefits

* Various voluntary benefit offerings

* Discount programs

* Parental leaves

new_roles.title: Director Internal Fill Finish Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Greenbush
* Req ID:R52954
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. Regeneron is currently looking for a Director of Internal Fill Finish Manufacturing to join our Industrial Operations and Product Supply (IOPS) team. This leadership role is accountable for the aseptic filling operation for clinical and commercial drug products, including vials and syringes in both liquid and lyophilized formats. The Director owns the full filling value stream: materials management; preparation of equipment, format parts, and components; formulation of drug product and placebo; aseptic filling; and lyophilization. The Director also ensures a seamless handoff to downstream finishing operations (Visual Inspection, syringe safety systems and autoinjector assembly, packaging, labeling, and serialization) and oversees facility cleaning and contamination control for the filling suites.

This role focuses on the start-up and execution of compliant GMP aseptic operations, ensuring the facility is properly staffed and trained, and supporting a dynamic, flexible production planning process that meets the needs of Regeneron’s patients. The Director will work directly with Drug Substance and Finish manufacturing management to ensure production timelines are met and will be a key member of various management teams within IOPS.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.

**When & where:**

* Location: Rensselaer, NY
* Work model: Monday- Friday, 8am-4:30pm

**Discover your role:**

* Provides leadership, vision, and management to the Filling team and its supporting functions, and leads all aspects of Filling operations at the facility to manufacture commercial and clinical parenteral medicines according to approved protocols, regulations, and schedules
* Directly oversees aseptic filling of drug product and placebo into vials and syringes, in liquid and lyophilized formats, including stoppering, capping, and crimping
* Directly oversees formulation of bulk drug product and placebo, including solution preparation and sterile filtration
* Directly oversees preparation of equipment, format parts, and components to support aseptic filling, including washing, depyrogenation, sterilization, and setup of filling lines
* Directly oversees lyophilization operations, including loading, cycle execution, and unloading, as well as the management of materials and components required to support filling operations
* Directly oversees cleaning and sanitization of filling suites, including Graded space (Grade A–D) and Controlled Non-Classified rooms (iCNC), and supports the site contamination control strategy, environmental monitoring, and aseptic process simulations (media fills)
* Ensures a smooth, timely handoff of filled product to downstream finishing operations (Visual Inspection, assembly, packaging, and labeling) in partnership with the leaders of those areas
* Troubleshoots and resolves issues impeding filling deliverables, including equipment performance, line interventions, and yield; provides technical input to resolve filling and aseptic process challenges
* Partners with department Directors and Project Management to implement new filling processes, including new formats, PFS and vial filling lines, formulation, aseptic filling, and lyophilization
* Manages department metrics and goals, monitors performance to objectives, and drives continuous improvement initiatives essential to meeting patient and business needs
* Leads the annual merit performance review process, builds departmental structure, and develops long-term staffing plans, including aseptic gowning qualification and training programs
* Collaborates with department Directors to support development of the annual budget, and rapidly and accurately communicates issues to department Directors
* Writes, reviews, and/or approves Standard Operating Procedures, specifications, regulatory filings, or other controlled documents as needed
* Executes Quality Management System assignments (CAPA, Deviation, Investigation, Change Control, etc.)
* Participates in the development and maintenance of a safe manufacturing environment and ensures that IOPS safety standards are maintained
* Oversees, supports, and participates in cGMP audits of all filling areas within the facility; maintains site inspection readiness and represents the filling operation during regulatory and client audits

**This role requires:**

* BS in any of the physical or biological sciences or chemical engineering, with biopharmaceutical/biotech experience in a GMP drug product production facility, including aseptic filling experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
 + Director: 12+ years of experience
 + Senior Director: 15+ years of experience
 + Level will be determined based on experience
* Experience overseeing aseptic filling operations in a biologics manufacturing environment, including vial and prefilled syringe filling
* Working knowledge of lyophilization, formulation, and aseptic technique, including barrier and isolator/RABS technologies
* Working knowledge of contamination control, environmental monitoring, and aseptic process simulation requirements
* Experience with multiproduct biologics facility start-up is preferred
* Experience interacting with multiple health authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA)

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.

 
 

Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.

 
 

As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.

 
 

For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.

 
 

**Salary Range (annually)**

$175,700.00 - $292,700.00

new_roles.description:
PSG® is the global pump, metering and dispensing-solution expert, enabling the safe and efficient transfer of critical and valuable fluids that require optimal performance and reliability in applications where it matters most. Additionally, PSG is a leading provider of flow meters designed to reduce waste and downtime while accurately measuring, monitoring and controlling the distribution of fluids. Headquartered in Downers Grove, IL, USA, PSG is comprised of several world-class brands, including Abaque®, All-Flo™, Almatec®, Blackmer®, Ebsray®, em-tec®, Griswold®, Hydro™, Malema™, Mouvex®, Neptune®, PSG® Biotech, Quantex™, Quattroflow®, and Wilden®. PSG products are manufactured on three continents – North America, Europe, and Asia – in state-of-the-art facilities that practice lean manufacturing and are ISO-certified. PSG is part of the Pumps & Process Solutions segment of Dover Corporation. For additional information on PSG, please visit psgdover.com.

We thrive on winning and being number one; and are always looking to add the best and brightest to our talented team of professionals. PSG offers a unique combination of the both small company atmosphere: with an ownership mindset that allows you to make close-to-the-customer decisions; an innovative approach in seeing beyond what is possible today and entrepreneurial spirit in the pursuit of new opportunities; combined with benefits of a large company’s scale, tools, expertise, and financial strength with Dover. Join PSG, a growing global company where your curiosity, hard work and ambition is rewarded with exceptional career opportunities in a friendly & fast paced environment.

PSG is part of the Pumps and Process Solutions segment of the Dover Corporation® (NYSE: DOV). Dover is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider with annual revenue of over $7 billion. We deliver innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions, and support services through five operating segments. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 65 years, our team of over 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible.

**Position Summary:**

 

Reporting to the site General Manager, the Director of Operations will manage the daily production, inventory, and logistics to ensure save, efficient, cost-effective, and timely delivery to our customers. They are responsible for development and implementation of strategy, growth, and profitability targets for the PSG-Grand Rapids facility. They will have direct ownership for established safety, quality, delivery, inventory, productivity, and lean objectives. Additional areas of reasonability include but are not limited to the oversight of: Safety, Plant Management, Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain, Capital Equipment, Facilities Planning, Workforce Development, and Operations Strategy Deployment. A successful individual will deploy and maintain strong operational processes, be data driven, drive continuous improvement, and empower his or her team to solve problems.

 

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

 

* Manage business to achieve/exceed agreed-upon growth, revenue, and operating income objectives
* Oversee end-to-end supply chain partnerships, warehousing, inventory management, and transportation
* Ensure products meet operations’ profitability goals
* Establish strategic direction, performance metrics, standards, and measurements for direct reports and the operation as a whole that support safety, quality, and delivery expectations
* Sets operational goals and objectives, and guides teams to meet monthly, quarterly and annual targets
* Partner with internal stakeholders to manage the P&L and continuously execute to achieve revenue and margin commitments
* Provide support and leadership to the supply chain, production planning, manufacturing, and continuous improvement teams by:
 + Supporting sales & operations planning (S&OP) process, and planning manufacturing capacity accordingly to ensure on time and efficient delivery
 + Identifying and responding to trends in the marketplace, anticipating and applying strategies to be ahead of the cost and quality curve
 + Planning and executing a best in class supply chain to ensure appropriate levels of inventory and turns as well as supplier quality and cost
 + Directing the continuous improvement program and supporting on site initiatives as required to ensure adoption of programs and achievement of desired results
 + Ensuring that products are delivered on-time to customers and that products meet all customer expectations regarding quality and performance
 + Planning and implementing capital improvements for the site and operations
* Work proactively with and effectively engaging functional counterparts to ensure overall organizational success and continuity of leadership
* Partner with union leadership to maintain compliance with the collective bargaining agreement while supporting operational goals
* Foster a positive employee relations environment through building a culture where employees are motivated and actively engaged in driving continuous improvement in the business
* Conducts performance evaluations, coaches and mentors, provides feedback, and takes action as needed to build a high-performing department
Embody the Company’s ethics and values; maintain the highest corporate governance principles 

**Qualifications** :

 

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, operations management, or a related field is required
* MBA/Master’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred
* Minimum of 10+ years of experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or other operational leadership role
* Experience in a build to order/high-mix manufacturing environment required
* Proven background in the application of production/inventory control, procurement procedures and techniques, and logistics

This position is eligible to earn a discretionary bonus based on performance metrics and other criteria outlined in our applicable bonus plan.We consider several job-related, non-discriminatory factors when determining the pay rate for a position, including, but not limited to, the position’s responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, a candidate’s education/training, the position’s location, and the key skills needed for the position. Pay is one of the Total Rewards that we provide to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other factors prohibited by law.

Fraudulent Recruiting Disclaimer: Dover Corporation and our affiliated operating companies want to alert applicants to internet job posting fraud, where parties posing as Dover employees, recruiters, or other agents, try to engage with online candidates in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. We do not endorse or engage in any recruitment practices that involve payment or personal information outside of our official application and hiring process. Please verify the authenticity of an invitation to apply for a job, or for a job offer by contacting us directly through our Dover and affiliated operating company websites at https://careers.dovercorporation.com/ . To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice on our careers site.

Attention Applicants: If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, please let us know. Likewise, if you are limited in the ability to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, we will determine an alternate way for you to apply. Please contact accommodations@psgdover.com for assistance with an accommodation. Kindly specify Job Requisition Number / Job Title and Location in response.

new_roles.title: Director Factory of the Future
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

**About AbbVie**

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**

The Director, Factory of the Future, leads AbbVie’s global strategy, design standards, and delivery of next-generation factories and manufacturing operations that leverage Industry 4.0/5.0, robotics, automation, and AI. The Director owns the Factory of the Future vision and roadmap across biotechnology, aseptic manufacturing, packaging, medical device, and chemical production, and leads a team of senior engineers and technical leaders who develop reference designs, run pilots, and enable deployment into new facilities and major site transformations. This role partners with Operations leadership, Engineering, Quality, PDS&T, Supply Chain, BTS, and Security to ensure future factories are safe, compliant, flexible, and highly automated, and deliver measurable gains in quality, speed, and cost.

**Vision and Strategy**

* **Factory of the Future strategy:** Define and own the multi-year Factory of the Future vision, technology roadmap, and investment case, aligned to Operations, network, and enterprise AI and digital strategies.
* **Network and capital alignment:** Partner with Global Engineering, Manufacturing, and Finance to embed future-factory design principles and technology choices into the capital plan, site master plans, and new-facility business cases.

**Design and Technology Leadership**

* **Reference designs and standards:** Establish global reference designs, design standards, and technology platforms for aseptic and biologics manufacturing, packaging, device assembly, and chemical production, including modular, flexible, and continuous concepts.
* **Automation, robotics, and AI:** Direct the evaluation, piloting, and scale-up of robotics, autonomous material handling, vision inspection, digital twins, advanced process control, and AI-enabled operations, in partnership with BTS and Operations AI.
* **Technical governance:** Provide design authority and review for major capital projects; ensure cGMP, Annex 1, data integrity, device regulations, EHS, and OT/IT cybersecurity requirements are built in from concept stage.

**Delivery and Value**

* **Portfolio delivery:** Lead a portfolio of Factory of the Future pilots, proofs of concept, and project deployments, managing scope, schedule, budget, risk, and benefits.
* **Value tracking:** Define KPIs (e.g., OEE, right-first-time, labor productivity, cycle time, capex efficiency, sustainability) and report realized value to the Operations Leadership Team.

**Leadership and Ecosystem**

* **Team leadership:** Build, lead, and develop a global team of principal and senior principal engineers and technical specialists; create a pipeline of future-factory talent.
* **External engagement:** Develop strategic relationships with equipment OEMs, automation integrators, technology startups, academia, and industry bodies (e.g., ISPE) to benchmark and access emerging capabilities.
* **Executive communication:** Represent Factory of the Future in executive and enterprise forums, translating technical concepts into business outcomes.

 
**Qualifications** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Biomedical, Electrical, Automation, Industrial, or related) required; Master’s, PhD, or MBA preferred.
* Minimum of 18 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device manufacturing, engineering, or technology, including 8+ years leading teams and large capital or technology programs.
* Proven record of leading greenfield/brownfield facility design or major site transformations from concept through startup.
* Expertise in aseptic and sterile manufacturing and/or biologics; experience across packaging, device, or chemical production is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated leadership in deploying Industry 4.0/5.0 technologies (robotics, automation, MES/MOM, IIoT, digital twins, AI/ML) at scale in GMP environments.
* Strong command of cGMP, Annex 1, data integrity, computer system assurance, and OT/IT cybersecurity expectations.
* Ability to build business cases and manage multi-million-dollar budgets and portfolios.
* Executive presence and ability to influence senior leaders across a global matrix organization.
* Experience developing and leading high-performing technical teams, including senior technical talent.
* Professional certifications (PE, PMP, ISPE CPIP) and a record of external publications, patents, or industry leadership are a plus.

 
**Additional Information**

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law:

* The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.
* We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
* This job is eligible to participate in our long-term incentive programs.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

US & Puerto Rico only - to learn more, visit https://www.abbvie.com/join-us/equal-employment-opportunity-employer.html

US & Puerto Rico applicants seeking a reasonable accommodation, click here to learn more:

https://www.abbvie.com/join-us/reasonable-accommodations.html

new_roles.title: Director of Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
Director of Manufacturing

**POSITION SUMMARY**
====================

Weaver Popcorn is seeking an experienced manufacturing leader to direct the **Malden, Missouri** operation and strengthen safety, quality, service, cost performance, throughput, and associate development. The Director of Manufacturing provides strategic and hands-on leadership for plant operations, maintenance, sanitation, scheduling, grower partnership, and continuous improvement while ensuring reliable execution of annual operating priorities.

This leader will establish clear performance expectations, develop plant leadership and frontline capability, optimize equipment and labor effectiveness, and partner across Quality, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, and Continuous Improvement to deliver sustainable operational and financial results.

**HOW WILL YOU HELP US GROW?**
==============================

**Manufacturing & Operational Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Lead the Malden manufacturing operation with accountability for safety, quality, service, cost, throughput, schedule attainment, sanitation, labor effectiveness, and overall plant performance.
* Establish clear operational standards, performance goals, equipment expectations, and operating cost objectives aligned with the annual plan.
* Drive reliable production output and efficient growth by ensuring the right equipment, staffing, operating systems, and performance measures are in place.
* Lead regular operating reviews with plant leadership to evaluate productivity, downtime, quality, staffing, schedule attainment, and corrective actions.
* Ensure manufacturing systems, procedures, and policies are consistently deployed, understood, and followed across assigned operations.
* Align internal manufacturing capabilities with customer needs, production schedules, raw-material availability, and growth expectations.

**Safety, Quality & Food Manufacturing Compliance**
---------------------------------------------------

* Provide visible leadership for a safe workplace and hold leaders accountable for proactive hazard identification, corrective action, training, and compliance.
* Partner closely with Quality leadership to ensure compliance with food safety and quality requirements, including HACCP, GMPs, sanitation standards, product controls, and applicable regulatory and customer requirements.
* Support disciplined investigation and sustainable corrective action for safety events, quality deviations, operational failures, customer concerns, and recurring performance issues.
* Ensure plant practices support audit readiness, traceability, sanitation effectiveness, and consistent production of safe, conforming product.
* Reinforce the authority and responsibility to stop or correct work when safety, food safety, quality, or regulatory requirements are not being met.

**Continuous Improvement, Reliability & Capital**
-------------------------------------------------

* Deploy Lean manufacturing, Statistical Process Control, and structured problem-solving methods to improve throughput, yield, reliability, labor efficiency, and cost performance.
* Identify operational failures and constraints, establish root causes, implement corrective actions, and verify sustained effectiveness.
* Develop and maintain meaningful manufacturing KPIs and equipment-efficiency measures that support timely, fact-based decisions.
* Partner with Maintenance and plant leaders to improve equipment reliability, preventive maintenance effectiveness, space utilization, and production capacity.
* Jointly establish capital expenditure priorities and lead effective execution of approved capital and process-improvement projects.
* Challenge existing practices, standardize successful improvements, and build continuous-improvement capability throughout the operation.

**Grower, Supply Chain & Cross-Functional Partnership**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Collaborate with Field Operations to support grower relationships, contracted acreage plans, raw-material supply, and growth objectives.
* Partner with Supply Chain and plant scheduling teams to balance customer requirements, inventory, capacity, labor, and raw-material availability.
* Work with Finance and Information Technology to strengthen business processes, operating data, management reporting, budgeting, and decision-support tools.
* Contribute the manufacturing perspective to companywide initiatives led by Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Quality, and other functional leaders.
* Communicate operational risks, priorities, tradeoffs, and performance clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**
------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop plant leaders and assigned functional leaders; establish clear goals, accountabilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Build a culture of excellence, ownership, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement at every level of the operation.
* Develop internal talent, strengthen succession readiness, and partner with Human Resources to recruit and retain a capable workforce.
* Build associate competency through effective training, qualification, coaching, and skills-development programs.
* Use a visible, participative leadership style that communicates direction, listens for understanding, addresses conflict directly, and earns followership.

**WHAT DO YOU NEED TO HAVE?**
=============================

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Operations Management, or a related field.
* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 10 years in a Plant Manager or comparable senior manufacturing leadership role; food or agricultural processing experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success applying Lean manufacturing, Statistical Process Control, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving methods to improve throughput, equipment efficiency, labor productivity, yield, and cost performance.
* Experience leading workplace safety, food manufacturing quality systems, sanitation, GMPs, HACCP-based programs, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Proven financial acumen, including budgeting, P&L accountability, capital prioritization, and analysis of manufacturing KPIs and cost drivers.
* Demonstrated success developing leaders, strengthening organizational capability, managing change, and building accountability in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
* Ability to travel regionally approximately 15% and remain available outside normal business hours when operational needs require support.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Leadership experience in popcorn, corn, grain, ingredient, food processing, or a related agricultural manufacturing environment.
* Experience leading capital projects, technical teams, maintenance-reliability programs, and high-engagement employee relations.
* Formal training or certification in Lean, Six Sigma, safety, continuous improvement, or project leadership.
* Experience partnering directly with growers or agricultural supply networks.

**WHERE & WHEN WILL YOU WORK?**
===============================

This role operates across office, agricultural, warehouse, and food manufacturing environments and requires regular presence in production areas. The typical schedule is Monday through Friday; however, the Director of Manufacturing must be available outside normal business hours, including occasional evenings or weekends, when safety, quality, customer, staffing, equipment, or other operational needs require support. Regional travel of approximately 15% is expected, with additional travel based on business needs.

**WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE?**
================================

* Strong, sustained performance in safety, quality, service, cost, throughput, schedule attainment, and customer satisfaction.
* Improved equipment reliability, operating efficiency, labor effectiveness, yield, and cost performance supported by clear KPIs.
* Consistent execution of manufacturing, sanitation, food safety, quality, and operating standards.
* Disciplined problem solving that reduces recurring failures and produces measurable, sustained improvement.
* A capable and accountable plant leadership team with clear goals, stronger bench strength, and active development plans.
* Effective partnership across Quality, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, and Continuous Improvement.
* Credible, visible leadership that builds ownership, engagement, and confidence throughout the Malden operation.

**HOW WILL WE HELP YOU GROW?**
==============================

* Competitive compensation.
* Three weeks of paid time off in the first year.
* 401(k) plan with a company match of 100% of employee deferrals up to 10%.
* Health, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance beginning the first day of the month following 30 days of employment.
* Education reimbursement of up to $15,000 per year.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
================================

Weaver Popcorn is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and associates. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

*The role responsibilities are many, various, and not limited to those written in this document.*

new_roles.title: Plant Manager - Metals Stamping
new_roles.description:
**Are you a leader who sees opportunity where others see challenges?**

Lake Air Products is looking for an entrepreneurial-minded Plant Manager to lead our metal stamping operation in New Hope, MN. This is an opportunity for a driven, hands-on leader who thrives on challenges and has the vision and determination to transform an operation and drive it to the next level.

We are a growing manufacturing company with big opportunities ahead, and we're looking for someone who wants to play a critical role in that success. This isn't a position for someone who simply wants to maintain the status quo. We need a leader who takes ownership, drives accountability, embraces change, and knows how to turn opportunities into results.

At Lake Air Products, we are proud to live by our Core Values: **Customer Focus, Passion for Performance, and Right People – Best Teams.** If you're energized by building strong teams, improving performance, and creating a culture where people and operations thrive, we'd like to hear from you!

**What You'll Do**

As Plant Manager, you will have significant influence over the performance, culture, and future direction of the New Hope operation. You will lead a team of manufacturing departments, including scheduling, stamping, assembly, and shipping/receiving, with 3-5 direct reports.

* **Own the Results:** Take full accountability for plant performance, driving measurable improvements in Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC), productivity, output, and overall operational effectiveness.
* **Drive Change & Transformation:** Identify opportunities, challenge existing processes, and lead meaningful operational changes that improve performance and position the plant for long-term success.
* **Lead with an Entrepreneurial Mindset:** Think strategically, act decisively, take ownership, and approach challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset.
* **Build a High-Performing Team:** Develop, coach, and hold leaders accountable while creating an environment of engagement, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* **Drive Operational Excellence:** Establish and execute continuous improvement initiatives, set clear objectives, and ensure projects deliver measurable results.
* **Manage Financial Performance:** Own plant spending and budget performance, make sound business decisions, and identify opportunities to improve profitability and efficiency.
* **Invest in the Future:** Identify and justify capital investments (CAPEX), clearly communicating anticipated benefits, business impact, and return on investment.
* **Lead Through Communication:** Establish effective tier meetings, maintain clear communication across all levels, and partner with Engineering, HR, Customer Support, and senior leadership.
* **Champion Customer Success:** Ensure production priorities and operational decisions support customer expectations for quality, delivery, and service.
* **Promote a Strong Culture:** Uphold Lake Air Products' Core Values, build productive employee relationships, and partner with HR to strengthen retention and employee satisfaction.
* **Maintain Compliance:** Ensure adherence to the company's ISO Quality Management System, departmental procedures, and work instructions.

Lake Air Products Offers:

* Competitive wage
* Full benefits package
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and Holiday Pay
* Gym reimbursement
* Tuition reimbursement

Qualifications

* Experience in Transition Leadership: Fast Growth > 15% per year, including operational turn arounds, fast expansions, etc.
* Ability to provide technical oversight, with the understanding of metal products and processes
* Proven success in contract manufacturing, producing 1000+ SKUs for 10+ customers
* Understanding and ability to pull data and analyze metrics related to budgets, KPI's, and efficiency reporting
* Cultural change agent, with strong leadership, influencing and mentoring skills.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems within a manufacturing environment, with Epicor experience preferred

*Please note that if this position may be subject to export control regulation. Unless an exemption applies, candidate(s) must be a U.S. Person\* within the meaning of the law OR obtain an export control license. Candidates who do not meet the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) requirements or choose not to pursue such positions are not disqualified from applying for other opportunities with Lake Air Products. Nothing in this posting should be interpreted as limiting applications based on nationality or citizenship status.* 
 

* *A U.S. Person under export control laws includes a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or protected individual who has been lawfully admitted for temporary residence in the U.S. as a refugee or asylee under U.S. law.*

new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

AZZ Inc. is a leading provider of specialized products and services designed to meet the unique needs of industrial markets worldwide. With a rich history spanning several decades, AZZ has established a strong reputation for innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction.

At AZZ, our culture is defined by **trust**, **respect**, **accountability**, **integrity**, **teamwork** and **safety** ("TRAITS"). We are dedicated to our employees by fully training and equipping them and providing a safe environment to grow personally and professionally. We strive to build, maintain and create a work environment that attracts and retains employees who are high contributors, have outstanding skills, are engaged in our culture, and who embody our Company mission: to create superior value in a culture where people can grow both professionally and personally, and where TRAITS matter.

As AZZ Inc. continues to evolve and innovate, it remains committed to driving shareholder value while maintaining its reputation as a leader in industrial solutions. With a strong foundation built on decades of experience and a forward-thinking approach, AZZ Inc. is poised to continue its upward trajectory, delivering sustainable growth and an unwavering commitment to excellence.

 **Job Description**

AZZ has an opportunity for a Plant Manager at our Canton facility. Reporting to the Regional Director of Operations, this role is responsible for, but not limited to, directing and managing all plant operations with overall responsibility for production, maintenance, quality, and personnel. You are a strong leader with a track record of effectively managing, mentoring, and developing leaders. You are experienced in developing and implementing business strategies and can deliver outstanding service to both internal and external stakeholders.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Directs and manages plant operations for production, maintenance, quality, shipping and receiving and all personnel activities.
* Develops and controls profits/loss, business plans and budget restrictions.
* Implements cost effective systems for control over capital, operating expenditures, manpower, wages, and salaries.
* Establishes and monitors overall plant performance for production and quality standards while maintaining strict process controls.
* Maintains existing plant facilities and equipment. Replaces or adjusts plant facilities and equipment when necessary.
* Provides leadership and training to accomplish the company goals and objectives.
* Implements and maintains preventative maintenance programs.
* Maintains and enforces OSHA and other safety regulations.
* Recommends or implements measures to motivate employees and to improve production methods, equipment performance, product quality or efficiency.
* Recommends personnel action including, but not limited to, annual evaluations, promotions, hiring and firing.
* Responsible for maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Serves as the primary direct report for all facility personnel.

 
**Qualifications** 

* 3 – 5 years of management experience **required**
* Experience in steel fabrication, metal coatings, or hot dip galvanizing **required**
* Proficient in all Microsoft Office applications, i.e., Excel, Outlook, and Word
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to effectively handle and manage confidential and sensitive information
* Knowledge of safety and OSHA rules and regulations required
* Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and SOPs for heavy industrial equipment

**Minimum Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree required

 
**Additional Information**

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and bonus structure.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits package.
* Retirement savings plan with company match.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development in a dynamic industry.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

#LI-Onsite

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

AZZ Inc. is a Drug Free Workplace

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

Oversee the assigned plant’s operations and maintenance delivered by the third-party operations and maintenance contractor (the Contractor) and take Company-level responsibility for safe, reliable, efficient and cost-effective power generation. Protect equipment condition and monitor delivery against agreed production, availability and contractual targets. Oversee plant resources, costs, records and stakeholder interfaces from commissioning and operational handover through ongoing operation.

The Contractor retains day-to-day operational control, provides the workforce and executes routine plant activities under the agreed contract. The Plant Manager is responsible for ensuring that the Contractor delivers plant results in line with the contract, overseeing its performance, giving technical and operational instructions to its site management as the contract allows, deciding the critical matters, and intervening when safety, performance, equipment integrity or delivery is at risk.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead plant readiness for commissioning and operational handover with Projects, Technical, HSE and the Contractor, ensuring personnel, training, procedures, spares, maintenance systems and emergency plans are ready.
* Drive closure of handover gaps and punch-list items before and after operational handover.
* Review and approve production and operating plans prepared with the Contractor, considering demand forecasts, available capacity, equipment limits and project commitments.
* Monitor generation, availability, reliability, capacity factor, heat rate, fuel and auxiliary consumption and forced-outage performance against targets; require corrective and improvement actions from the Contractor and verify they achieve the intended results.
* Oversee heat rate improvement and auxiliary consumption reduction initiatives with the Contractor and Technical teams, and obtain approval for proposed modifications under the change management procedure.
* Review the effect of startup/shutdown cycles and load-following operation on equipment life, thermal fatigue and availability, and agree operating and maintenance strategies with the Contractor and OEMs accordingly.
* Hold daily operating coordination and plant performance reviews with the Contractor’s management, resolve operational conflicts and maintain plant risk and action registers.
* Review and approve preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance plans, overhaul scopes and outage schedules prepared with the Contractor, taking account of OEM guidance, asset condition, warranty terms, production commitments and approved budgets.
* Oversee gas and steam turbine lifecycle management with the Contractor and OEMs, including tracking of life-limited parts, rotor and stator life and fatigue effects, and integrate it into maintenance and capital planning.
* Oversee maintenance and repair execution for work quality, timely completion and minimum disruption to generation; require recovery plans or changes to resources or work methods when delivery is at risk.
* Lead the response to major equipment failures with the Contractor’s specialists, Company engineers and OEMs: approve containment and recovery actions, ensure root cause analysis is completed and authorize safe return to service.
* Oversee the Contractor’s management of spare parts, consumables, chemicals and lubricants; set critical stock priorities, resolve shortages, review technical specifications of purchase requests and ensure technical acceptance, proper storage and effective inventory control.
* Manage plant interfaces with Technical teams for utilities and shared equipment under the agreed responsibility split, and ensure assigned statutory inspections are completed with the responsible functions.
* Administer the plant O&M contract and hold the Contractor to its agreed scope, staffing coverage, service levels and technical obligations; address nonperformance with its management and require recovery plans within contractual authority.
* Prepare formal notices and claim inputs with relevant functions.
* Oversee warranty and warranty claim processes and technical disputes with OEMs and suppliers, including long-term service agreement matters, and manage technical communication with them.
* Verify the Contractor’s invoices, labor hours, overtime, reimbursable costs, materials and subcontractor charges against contract rates, authorized work and actual delivery; challenge unsupported charges and recommend verified services for approval through the Company’s payment approval workflow.
* Prepare the plant O&M budget and forecasts, control commitments and expenditure against the approved budget and act on variances.
* Evaluate additional work requests, maintain change and claim records and obtain O&M Director approval for decisions beyond approved budget or contractual authority.
* Ensure accurate production, fuel-consumption and customer and revenue meter records and timely plant reporting; provide validated data and technical explanations to Commercial and Finance for customer billing and contractual reconciliations.
* Identify gaps in O&M service capability and recommend alternative O&M contractors or specialist support to the O&M Director; contribute to technical scopes, contractor sourcing and proposal evaluation, and manage site transition and handover to preserve operating continuity when the Contractor changes.
* Oversee plant HSE requirements with HSE and the Contractor’s management, including work permits, energy isolation, waste controls and emergency preparedness; stop unsafe work and direct immediate containment and incident response under site procedures.
* Ensure plans are in place for high-risk process safety scenarios (gas or steam turbine trips, HRSG pressure events, plant blackout) and lead the response in a crisis.
* Promote a safety culture through visible leadership, participation in safety activities and training, and ensure that work is carried out with safety as an integral part of the job.
* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental permits, emission limits and monitoring and reporting requirements, in coordination with HSE and Permitting.
* Lead plant coordination with customers, grid operators and other stakeholders under agreed communication protocols, including dispatch communication and contractual availability and performance obligations.
* Ensure the plant meets grid operator and off-taker requirements for frequency, voltage, reactive power and load-change capability.
* Lead inspection and audit preparation and ensure responsible parties complete corrective actions, records and required submissions.
* Review the Contractor’s staffing and shift plans against contract requirements, require adequate competence and coverage and resolve staffing deficiencies through its management. Recruitment, payroll and employment administration remain with the Contractor.
* Ensure accurate operating, maintenance and equipment records and timely daily, weekly and monthly performance reports, including capacity utilization analysis, to the O&M Director.
* Ensure plant administrative, operating and maintenance procedures and documentation are established and aligned with applicable safety, environmental and quality management system requirements, and follow the Company’s risk management approach.
* Contribute to short, medium and long-term plant strategy, including reliability and capital investment planning, with the O&M Director.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Energy Systems, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of power generation O&M experience in natural gas-fired combined cycle plants, with responsibility for plant operations, maintenance and technical team leadership.
* Hands-on knowledge of combined cycle systems, including heavy-duty gas turbines, HRSGs, steam turbines, generators, water and steam chemistry, balance-of-plant equipment and DCS controls, with the ability to lead complex troubleshooting.
* Prior Plant Manager, Operations Manager or Maintenance Manager experience at a combined cycle plant.
* Experience with the gas turbine technology installed at the assigned plant (for example Siemens Energy or GE frame units).
* Experience planning and managing major outages and inspections (combustion, hot gas path, major overhaul) with OEMs and multiple contractors.
* Experience overseeing an outsourced O&M contractor or equivalent contract oversight, including performance management, labor-hour and invoice control, budgets and reporting.
* Experience with OEM long-term service agreements and warranty management.
* US operating experience, including independent power producers or owner-side operations.
* Working knowledge of NERC reliability requirements as applicable, environmental permit and emissions compliance, lockout/tagout and permit-to-work systems, and EHS regulations.
* Understanding of power market operations, including dispatch, availability obligations and commercial reporting to customers.
* Competence in CMMS and reporting tools; fluent English and MS Office proficiency.
* Training or certification in combined cycle O&M, leadership and team management, and problem-solving and decision-making techniques is preferred.
* Authorization to work in the United States. Ability to work at the assigned US site, travel as required.

The Plant Manager is responsible for ensuring that the Contractor delivers plant results in line with the contract, overseeing its performance, giving technical and operational instructions to its site management as the contract allows, deciding the critical matters, and intervening when safety, performance, equipment integrity or delivery is at risk.

new_roles.description:
POSITION TITLE: Plant Manager 
CLASSIFICATION: Exempt 
REPORTS TO: Plant Manager I 
SUPERVISES: Yes

POSITION PURPOSE: 
Responsible for overseeing and supervising the manufacturing and distribution departments by establishing, monitoring and enforcing policies and procedures to ensure that departments run smoothly and are aligned to quality standards. Creates and executes on strategies and policies for company growth. 
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND BASIC DUTIES: 

* Oversee and supervise the Manufacturing and Distribution departments.
* Provide for the timely manufacture and distribution of product against customer orders.
* Anticipates and tracks operational and tactical risks and providing strategic solutions.
* Plays a significant role in long-term planning, project status reporting, and implementing change control processes.
* Maintain average workdays to manufacture and ship all published catalog items.
* Maintain average workdays to manufacture and ship all custom manufactured items (RCC label)
* Provide monthly responses to budget variance.
* Provide for utilization planning by weekly reporting of the average Work-in-Process.
* Perform physical inventories of raw materials, packaging components, and finished goods.
* Provide for an appropriate balance of inventory to meet performance and financial objectives.
* Implement plant safety programs and ensure compliance with GMP.
* Confirm that appropriate work instructions are developed and maintained and followed throughout the business.
* Ensure that all ISO quality systems are followed.
* Provide compliance to ISO quality systems (i.e. Corrective Action)
* Oversee facilities and grounds maintenance.
* Oversees and reports weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual metrics.
* Identifies trends and assess opportunities to improve processes and execution.
* Completes reasonability testing and information validation prior to circulating findings and recommendations to key stakeholders.
* Solicits and responds to feedback while gaining commitment and support.
* Stays up to date on industry regulations, trends, and technology.
* Manage and supervise employees, resolve problems, and make recommendations for staffing and interviewing candidates for employment.
* Responsible for annual personnel reviews.
* Champions Functional Training Document (FTD) program through employee learning and development initiatives; standards of excellence & leader/employee accountability.
* Other Duties as assigned.
* Commitment to the organizations values; High Standards, Bias for Action, Teamwork, Customer

Obsession, Trust, Accountability, Innovation and Growth & Learning. 
Items covered in this job description are not all-inclusive of the expectations to perform this job 
satisfactorily. There may be times where management may require that you perform task not listed in this 
job description.

REQUIRED SKILLS: 

* Addressing operational concerns and issues, monitoring overall customer satisfaction.
* Developing and implementing operational procedures and policies.
* Analyzing training needs/requirements.
* Excellent interpersonal communication and organizing skills to coordinate project activities.
* Ability to communicate with others effectively.
* Ability to conduct research for special projects, respond timely inquiries, and present written/ oral briefings.
* Ability to work with details and time-sensitive issues.
* Good decision-making skills and response to high-pressure situations.
* Managing processes, developing standard.
* Tracking budget expenses, financial skills.
* Performance management.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: 

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry or Engineering-related discipline or a business-related area or equivalent work experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum of eight (8) years manufacturing management experience supervising manufacturing employees.
* Minimum of two (2) years of recent overall project management experience.
* Knowledge of HazMat, ISO, Distribution and safety programs.
* Experience with Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel skills with the ability to manipulate spreadsheets, create pivot tables and summarize data from multiple sources
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to work independently and with the team with strong follow through
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Accuracy and attention to detail
* A Project Management Professional (PMP) certified by the Project Management Institute (PMI) can be used in lieu of the educational requirements

WORK ENVIRONMENT: 
The physical environment may require the employee to work both inside and outside in heat/cold, wet/humid, and dry/arid conditions. This position may be working in the warehouse under various indoor environmental conditions, including supplemental heating in the winter months and without air-conditioning in the summer months. May be requested to work overtime and weekends. The position may occasionally be exposed to ruptured, leaking packages, some of which may contain Hazardous Materials. Where appropriate, proper safety equipment should be utilized and/or appropriate personnel notified. Frequently required to use personal protective equipment to prevent exposure to hazardous materials and chemicals. This job may require lifting of up to 50 pounds occasionally.

All descriptions have been reviewed to ensure that only essential functions and basic duties have been included. Peripheral tasks, only incidentally related to each position, have been excluded. 
Items covered in this job description are not all-inclusive of the expectations to perform this job 
satisfactorily. There may be times where management may require that you perform task not listed in this 
job description. 
Requirements, skills, and abilities included have been determined to be the minimal standards required to successfully perform the positions. In no instance, however, should the duties, responsibilities, and requirements delineated be interpreted as all-inclusive. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate. 
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, it is possible that requirements may be modified to reasonably accommodate disabled individuals. However, no accommodations will be made which may pose serious health or safety risks to the employee or others or which impose undue hardships on the organization. 
Job descriptions are not intended as and do not create employment contracts. The organization maintains its status as an at-will employer. Employees can be terminated for any reason not prohibited by law.

new_roles.title: Industrial Gases Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

The Industrial Gases Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable, and cost-effective operation of an industrial gases production facility, ensuring uninterrupted production and supply of products such as oxygen, nitrogen, argon, hydrogen, and CO₂. The role provides leadership for operations, maintenance, safety, quality, and continuous improvement while meeting business, customer, and regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead all plant operations to achieve safety, production, quality, and reliability targets.
* Ensure compliance with environmental, health, safety, and process safety management (PSM) standards.
* Drive operational excellence through continuous improvement, productivity, and energy-efficiency initiatives.
* Oversee maintenance and reliability programs to maximize plant uptime and asset performance.
* Manage plant budgets, operating costs, and capital improvement projects.
* Lead, coach, and develop plant personnel, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.
* Ensure compliance with quality systems, customer specifications, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with supply chain, logistics, engineering, and commercial teams to ensure uninterrupted product supply.
* Lead root cause investigations and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Support plant expansions, upgrades, and commissioning activities.

**Management Responsibilities**

Directly manages plant leadership and operational personnel, including maintenance, operations, and technical staff. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, training, coaching, performance management, disciplinary action, succession planning, and employee development.

**Other Duties**

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Duties and responsibilities may be modified at any time to meet the business needs of the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in industrial gases, chemicals, petrochemicals, refining, or other continuous process industries.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing industrial gases plant operations.
* Strong knowledge of cryogenic processes, compressors, rotating equipment, utilities, and process control systems.
* Experience with DCS/PLC systems, reliability practices, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Demonstrated leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

**Key Competencies**

* Safety Leadership
* Operational Excellence
* Team Development
* Financial & Business Acumen
* Reliability & Asset Management
* Strategic Thinking
* Communication & Stakeholder Management

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* Plant availability and reliability
* Production efficiency and energy consumption
* Product quality performance
* Budget and cost management
* Employee engagement and development
* Customer supply reliability

**Reports To**: President Plants and Operation Department

**Direct Reports**: Maintenance Manager and Plant Operations Team.

**Work Environment**

This position operates primarily within an industrial manufacturing environment and office setting. The Plant Manager regularly works in and around production equipment, compressors, cryogenic systems, utilities, and other industrial process operations. The role routinely uses standard office equipment, including computers, phones, scanners, and related technology. Frequent interaction with plant employees, contractors, customers, regulatory agencies, and corporate leadership is required. Occasional travel to company facilities, customer sites, industry meetings, and training programs may be required.

**Physical Demands**

This role requires a combination of office-based and plant-floor activities. The employee is frequently required to sit, stand, walk, climb stairs and ladders, communicate effectively, and use a computer for extended periods. The position may require working in varying environmental conditions, including exposure to industrial noise, temperature fluctuations, and process equipment. The ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, hard hats, hearing protection, steel-toed footwear, and other safety equipment as required, is essential. The employee may occasionally be required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

**Position Type and Expected Hours of Work**

This is a full-time exempt position. The Plant Manager is expected to maintain a schedule sufficient to meet business and operational needs. Due to the nature of continuous industrial operations, the position may require availability outside normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, emergency response situations, planned maintenance outages, and on-call responsibilities as needed.

**Work Authorization**

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must maintain eligibility to work in the U.S. throughout their employment. Appropriate documentation authorizing employment in the United States is required upon hire.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

Air Water America is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to attracting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce and fostering an inclusive work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, military status, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws. Air Water America complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity laws and regulations and provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and religious observances as required by law.

new_roles.description:
### **Summary**

The Production Manager oversees the operations of the entire production facility (excluding purchasing, personnel, and non-production functions), with a focus on the Converting department. This role ensures adherence to company policies and procedures while driving optimal operational performance. The manager directly supervises Converting employees and supervisors.

**Perks of Pratt:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision Plans
* Short Term/Long Term Disability
* Supplemental Life Insurance Plans
* Child Bearing/Parental Leave
* 401K Plan with Company Match
* Paid Holidays/Paid Vacation
* Uniforms/Safety Shoes/Prescription Safety Glasses
* Healthy Lifestyles Program/ Virgin Pulse Fitness Tracker
* $500.0/Year Gym Membership Reimbursement100% Tuition Reimbursement/Assistance Program
* Income Protection Plans
* Legal & Travel Assistance Plans
* EAP/Home Auto Insurance Plans
* Wireless/Auto/Computer Discount Plans

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Production & Operations**

* Provide full production support, with a strong emphasis on converting machine performance.
* Maximize productivity and minimize downtime through effective resource management.
* Coordinate with Maintenance on PMs, MVP, and machine uptime goals.
* Oversee converting production, including equipment installation and major repairs.
* Support cost-reduction strategies and drive productivity improvements.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, safety protocols, and quality standards.

#### **Quality & Safety**

* Ensure plant focus on quality processes and tools for each converting machine.
* Maintain plant housekeeping standards and ensure machine cleaning programs are current.
* Drive safety initiatives and uphold OSHA, EPA, and company regulations.
* Oversee all audit protocols (third-party, customer, and internal).

#### **Leadership & Supervision**

* Directly supervise Converting employees and supervisors.
* Set and communicate quality, efficiency, and production standards.
* Provide training, coaching, conflict resolution, performance evaluations, and disciplinary action as needed.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, teamwork, and high morale.

#### **Administrative & Strategic Support**

* Evaluate new methods, machinery, and safety programs; contribute to planning, budgeting, and purchasing.
* Maintain optimal staffing levels daily.
* Communicate issues to the General Manager in a timely manner.
* Remain on-call and available after hours to address urgent production issues.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

### **Qualifications**

#### **Required**

* High school diploma or GED
* 10 years of experience in corrugated manufacturing
* 5 years of proven management experience in a production environment

#### **Preferred**

* College degree
