Job Summary - Why you’ll love this position

Are you motivated by the challenge of solving complex, enterprise-wide problems? Do you love asking "why" and transforming good operations into exceptional public experiences? If so, consider joining the State of Missouri as our next Director of Operational Excellence!

In this pivotal leadership role you will champion continuous improvement across state government, lead our operational initiatives, and oversee our statewide customer experience program. This position resides within the Office of Administration, the administrative arm of the executive branch, but leads efforts that span all executive agencies to improve service delivery to the citizens of Missouri.

We are seeking an energetic, visionary executive to lead and empower a dedicated team of process improvement and customer experience efforts while serving as a strategic partner to executive leadership, agency partners, and frontline public servants. Our next director is a bridge-builder who combines proven improvement methodologies with human-centered design, modern customer experience principles, rapid responsiveness to agency partner needs, and a passion for coaching state team members to achieve measurable public outcomes.

In addition to the inspiring work that will improve the services provided by state government and your colleagues work environment, you will receive a great benefits package that includes paid time off, medical/vision/dental insurance, life insurance, and retirement.

*The salary indicated represents a base pay rate. If the individual selected or the position is eligible for a pay differential (e.g., shift, security, or years of service), it will be added to the total compensation in your paycheck. A pay differential does not raise your base pay.*

Responsibilities - What you’ll do

* Work collaboratively with leadership and teams to encourage, develop, and execute strategies to create a culture of continuous improvement across Missouri state government. Measure the effectiveness of improvements and provide administration with visibility to such improvements.
* Act as a subject matter expert and promote change management by sharing Lean Six Sigma and other Operational Excellence best practices. Teach, mentor, coach and lead Operational Excellence leaders from every state department.
* Continuously provide helpful operational excellence resources for team members and facilitate training sessions.
* Model excellence in leadership and act with urgency to achieve results and lead efforts to cultivate a culture of data-based decision making.
* Facilitate, lead, and oversee state level strategic initiatives and other projects as assigned by leadership.
* Coordinate and host an annual Show Me Excellence Summit and represent the State of Missouri at national operational excellence events.

Qualifications - All you need for success

**Minimum Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Formal training in Lean Six Sigma or an equivalent continuous process improvement framework. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification is strongly preferred
* Demonstrated advanced knowledge in Lean and Operational Excellence frameworks and facilitation methodologies
* Hands-on experience work with survey, feedback, or data visualization platforms, such as Qualtrics, Tableau, or Power BI

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Must be action oriented, demonstrate superior organizational abilities and have strong facilitation skills and excellent communications skills.
* Ability to work with leaders and multi-level teams to establish goals, performance indicators, actions plans and deliverables and effectively communicating across broad audiences.
* Must have excellent leadership abilities. This individual must be an effective collaborator with energy, enthusiasm and a can-do attitude who can empower others, gain buy-in and achieve results.
* Good understanding of data analysis related to process improvement and an ability to analyze data to gain insights and support problem solving.
* Training, certification, and/or education in continuous process improvement programs such as Lean Six Sigma as well as completion of Missouri Way, Leadership Academy, and similar programs is preferred.

***Lack of post******‐******secondary education will not be used as the sole basis denying consideration to any applicant.***

Successful background check results are required for employment in this position. This may include background checks involving a candidate's name and/or fingerprints and other screenings as needed for the specific position.

Authorization to work in the United States is a prerequisite of employment. The Office of Administration will not sponsor applicants for work visas.

The State of Missouri offers an excellent benefits package that includes a defined pension plan, generous amounts of leave and holiday time, and eligibility for health insurance coverage. Your total compensation is more than the dollars you receive in your paycheck. This tool provides a comprehensive view of benefits and more that are offered to prospective employees. The Total Compensation Calculator and other applicant resources can be found here.

OARecruiters@oa.mo.gov

Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

With our rapidly growing portfolio, geographic reach, and Global Commercial Development (GCD) organization, we are seeking an experienced and enterprise-minded Executive Director, Global Commercial Development Operations to develop and implement key business processes, lead department operations, and strengthen planning, communication, and execution as the organization scales. This position reports to the SVP of Global Commercial Development and will serve as a core member of the GCD Leadership Team.

The role will partner with GCD functional leaders, other operations teams, and key corporate functions to establish effective ways of working and clear ownership across shared initiatives. In collaboration with Commercialization Effectiveness and Operations, this role will align GCD planning and processes with the broader commercialization organization.

In addition, this leader will build and lead GCD operations, department project coordination capabilities, supporting disease area teams, Analytics and Insights, Commercialization Partnerships, Companion Diagnostics, and Global Commercial Excellence.

Key Responsibilities

* Partner closely with the Head of GCD, GCD functional leaders, and key partners including HR, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Information Systems, and Corporate Relations to guide and execute department strategies, plans, and deliverables.
* Establish and manage GCD financial and strategic planning processes, including annual goals, operating plans, budgets, projections, and business reviews. Partner with Finance and functional leaders to track resources, identify gaps, and coordinate inputs into broader commercialization planning cycles.
* Play a central role in defining GCD organizational goals and short- and long-term priorities. Track milestones, dependencies, and progress, and communicate risks and decisions required to the appropriate leaders.
* Lead and plan GCD Leadership Team meetings and other department decision-making forums, working with relevant leaders to set agendas, preparing materials, document decisions, and ensure follow-through on commitments.
* Coordinate GCD participation in broader commercialization business reviews, planning milestones, and shared initiatives, working with the ED, CGCO Operations and other relevant partners as needed. Translate agreed priorities and decisions into clear GCD actions and deliverables.
* Lead coordination of GCD management presentations, briefing materials, and FAQs for launch readiness, portfolio, business performance, and other key reviews. Coordinate with relevant owners to provide consistent GCD inputs for Board, earnings, and other executive engagements.
* Build and lead a GCD project coordination capability to advance department priorities. Define project ownership, plans, milestones, and escalation paths, coordinating dependencies with teams responsible for launch readiness and Global Commercialization Team management.
* Partner with Commercialization Effectiveness and Operations (CE&O) on selected shared planning processes, tools, and ways of working. Coordinate with Global Commercial Excellence (GCE) and other capability teams to clarify responsibilities and support effective implementation within GCD.
* Partner with the Head of GCD to develop and implement a department communication strategy. Coordinate team meetings, project highlights, leadership updates, offsites, and recognition activities to clarify priorities, communicate progress, and strengthen team connection.
* Optimize interfaces across GCD, regional commercial teams, Medical Affairs, Global Access, Research and Development, and corporate functions. Facilitate information sharing, clarify responsibilities, and resolve or escalate operational issues that affect shared priorities.
* Build and scale GCD project management, governance, planning, and operational reporting capabilities. Partner with Analytics and Insights and Information Systems on tools and dashboards that track department execution, resource needs, and organizational goals.
* Lead change management efforts to support organizational growth and drive adoption of new tools, processes, and ways of working. Partner with HR and functional leaders on workforce planning, onboarding, role clarity, and team effectiveness, drawing on CE&O approaches where appropriate.
* Develop, grow, and lead a high-performing operations team, including department project coordinators. Coordinate capacity and support across GCD while working closely with project resources embedded in individual teams.
* Establish clear ownership of recurring GCD processes and workstreams with relevant functional leaders. Maintain documentation of processes, decisions, and open actions to support continuity as the organization evolves.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 15+ years of relevant experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare, including significant experience leading cross functional commercial or commercialization initiatives.
* Experience supporting commercialization organizations, including complex operational planning, launch readiness or brand planning, and capability development.
* Demonstrated Executive Director-level capability, including defining operating models, building organizational capabilities, and driving cross-functional alignment in evolving organizations.
* Strong functional and operational leadership skills, including process design, governance, project management, financial and resource planning, performance management, and change management.
* Proven success partnering with internal stakeholders to improve organizational effectiveness.
* Experience working across global and regional teams, with the ability to clarify accountabilities and coordinate work across different functions and geographies.
* Experience building and leading high-performing operations, or project management teams.
* Ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, balancing strategic judgment with hands-on execution and disciplined follow-through.
* Exceptional collaboration, communication, and interpersonal skills, including the ability to synthesize complex issues into clear executive materials and actionable plans.
* Sound judgment and discretion when managing confidential information, sensitive organizational topics, and competing leadership priorities.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Advanced degree such as an MBA, MS, or PhD.
* Oncology or specialty pharmaceutical commercialization experience.
* Experience partnering with an executive office or leadership team during rapid organizational growth and geographic expansion.

existing_roles.title: Director, Employee Operations Leader
existing_roles.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

**Overview**

Scout Motors is seeking an Employee Operations Leader to build and lead the infrastructure that powers exceptional employee experiences at scale. This leader will own Scout's HR service delivery, systems ecosystem, and data governance — the operational backbone of the HR function.

As Scout grows, this role will be responsible for ensuring that every employee has seamless access to HR support, that our HR technology is configured and governed to support accurate data and reliable operations, and that our processes are disciplined, efficient, and continuously improving. This leader will partner closely with the Chief Human Resources Officer, HR centers of excellence, IT, Finance, and business leaders to build a high-performing HR operations function fit for a fast-scaling company.

#### **What you'll do**

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Leadership & Team Development

* Lead, develop, and coach a team spanning HR operations, HR systems architecture, and LMS administration.
* Set a clear vision for HR operations and inspire the team to deliver consistent, high-quality service to employees and people leaders.
* Create a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence within the team.
* Partner with the CHRO and HR leadership team to align operational priorities with the broader HR strategy.
* Champion inclusion, collaboration, and Scout's cultural values within the team and across the function.

HR Service Delivery & Operations

* Oversee Scout's HR service delivery model including Tier 0 self-service tools with the use of AI, resources, knowledge bases, and exception-handling protocols.
* Ensure employees and managers have timely, accurate access to HR support and information.
* Set and monitor SLAs, service metrics, and quality standards for HR operations.
* Lead continuous improvement of service delivery processes to improve the employee and people leader experience, with heavy focus on ensuring HR data quality and enabling self service capabilities.
* Manage escalation pathways for complex or sensitive HR inquiries, ensuring consistent and compliant resolution.

HR Systems & Technology

* Own Scout's HR technology ecosystem, including HRIS, LMS, ATS, and potential future talent marketplace platforms.
* Partner with IT, vendors, and HR centers of excellence to evaluate, implement, and optimize HR technologies.
* In collaboration with IT and potentially other vendors, establish agentic AI as the first level of engagement (Tier 0) for employees and people leaders to respond routine inquiries
* Where necessary, establish a workflow for inquiries that require greater consideration and action from HR Partners or other Subject Matter Experts.
* Drive system governance including configuration decisions, access management, and platform roadmap planning.
* Ensure integrations between HR systems are stable, accurate, and aligned with business needs.
* Stay current on HR technology trends and proactively identify opportunities to modernize or streamline the HR tech stack.

Data, Reporting & Governance

* Own Scout's HR data strategy, reporting infrastructure, and workforce analytics capabilities.
* Establish data governance frameworks, standards, and audit processes that ensure data quality, accuracy, and compliance.
* Partner with Finance, Legal, and business stakeholders to deliver workforce reporting and insights that inform people and organizational decisions.
* Build dashboards and reporting tools that give leaders visibility into the health and performance of the workforce.

**Location & Travel Expectations**:

* This role will be based out of the **Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC**.
* This role requires 4 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.
* **Travel**: Domestic and minimal international travel may be required as business needs evolve. Valid driver's license required. Passport required

#### **What you'll bring**

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

* Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree, MBA, or advanced HR-related degree preferred.
* 12+ years of progressive HR experience with significant experience in HR operations, HRIS, or shared services leadership.
* Demonstrated experience managing and optimizing HR technology platforms such as HRIS, ATS, and LMS systems.
* Experience building or leading HR shared services or operations functions in high-growth or transformational environments.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort with HR data, metrics, reporting, and business intelligence tools.
* Experience managing cro$180,000.00 - $220,000.00s-functional projects and leading teams through technology implementations or process change.
* Exceptional organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance strategic vision with hands-on operational execution.
* Demonstrated grit, curiosity, and resourcefulness in navigating ambiguity, solving complex problems, and turning obstacles into practical, scalable solutions.
* High integrity, sound judgment, and a commitment to inclusion, fairness, and respect.
* Experience in startup, scaling, automotive, or manufacturing environments is strongly preferred.

#### **What you'll gain**

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

* Competitive insurance including:
  + Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans
* 401(k) program with:
  + An employer match and immediate vesting
* Generous Paid Time Off including:
  + 20 days planned PTO, as accrued
  + 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually
  + Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders
  + Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave
* Corporate Vehicle Program with:
  + Eligibility for 1 assigned vehicle
  + A mobility stipend

#### **Pay Transparency**

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $180,000.00 - $220,000.00

Internal leveling code: M6

**Notice to applicants:**

* To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.
* Residing in **San Francisco**: *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*
* Residing in **Los Angeles**: *Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.*
* Residing in **New York City**: *This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.*

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

Your Contribution
=================

The Head of Plant Production Engineering is responsible for leading all Production Engineering activities associated with customer projects, product acquisitions, new product launches, industrialization, and production readiness within the plant. This position serves as the plant's primary owner for Production Engineering processes, ensuring successful execution of the Product Development Process (PDP) from acquisition through Start of Production (SOP) and ramp-up. The role provides leadership to Production Engineers, drives standardization and deployment of manufacturing concepts, ensures manufacturability of product designs, manages capital investments, and represents Operations within project core teams. The Plant Head of Production Engineering ensures project launches meet safety, quality, delivery, cost, and operational performance objectives.

* Lead, develop, coach, & manage the plant Production Engineering organization.
* Build organizational capability to support current and future product launches.
* Own industrialization activities for all customer projects within the plant. Ensure successful execution of product launches from acquisition and business transfer through SOP and stabilization.
* Lead development of manufacturing concepts, production processes, line layouts, and assembly strategies.
* Ensure product designs are manufacturable and meet operational standards.
* Coordinate launch readiness across Manufacturing Engineering, Tooling Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Purchasing, and Operations Support acquisition reviews and participate in PAC, PRC, and pre-development activities.
* Ensure implementation of Design-for-Manufacturing principles throughout project development. Ensure compliance with MAHLE PDP milestones, gates, deliverables, and timing requirements. Oversee completion of all Production Engineering deliverables throughout all quality gates.
* Monitor project status, risks, cost performance, capacity requirements, and launch readiness. Lead escalation activities when project risks threaten timing, quality, or cost objectives. Review project dashboards and launch metrics with plant leadership and program teams.
* Approve and govern: Manufacturing concepts, Process flows, Plant layouts, Assembly concepts, Material flow strategies, Value stream integration.
* Ensure application of Lean Manufacturing and Manufacturing Optimization Process (MOP) methodologies in alignment with Operations Excellence Manager.
* Drive takt-time analysis, line balancing, ergonomic studies, and capacity planning. Validate cycle times using MTM or equivalent engineering methods. Ensure implementation of standardized manufacturing processes across the region.
* Ensure development, completion, and approval of Process FMEA (P-FMEA), Control Plans, Special Characteristics, Process Capability Studies, Validation Plans. Support flawless launch activities and manufacturing risk reduction. Lead readiness reviews for installation checks, internal process approval, internal run at rate, customer run at rate, PPAP readiness. Ensure production systems consistently achieve quality and operational KPI’s.
* Lead capital expenditure planning and approval activities. Validate business cases and investment requirements. Ensure optimal utilization of existing equipment before requesting new capital. Support supplier selection through PDC and SDC processes. Approve manufacturing equipment specifications. Participate in procurement and acceptance of production equipment, tooling, fixtures, and test systems.
* Chair Production Engineering project meetings, and lead the plant Production Engineering Extended Team, ensuring effective communication between Project Core Teams and Plant Extended Teams.

Your Experience & Qualifications

* Bachelor’s Degree required, B.S. in Engineering, or related technical discipline required. Master’s Degree preferred.
* 8+ years’ experience in manufacturing, launch, industrialization, or production engineering.
* 5+ years’ progressive leadership responsibility regarding engineering or manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated success in leading complex product launches and PDP projects.
* Experience in an automotive manufacturing facility required; high volume, medium to large campus experience preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge in IATF16949, ISO14001 and 45001 Audits and processes.
* Excellent diagnostic abilities / root cause analysis required; Lean Six Sigma and Black Belt certification strongly preferred.

We will provide a collaborative environment working on exciting assignments, along with ongoing personal & career development opportunities. existing_roles.title: General Manager, Data Operations
existing_roles.description:
**About David AI**
------------------

At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models.

Founded in 2024, we're a fast-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with ~70 people across San Francisco and New York City.

**About our Data Operations team**
----------------------------------

Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale.

This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.

**About this role**
-------------------

As **General Manager of Data Operations** at David AI, you will lead one of the most critical functions at David AI. You’ll own a major slice of our Data Factory: the engine that powers high-quality, scalable data production. You’ll lead the team responsible for building and scaling pipelines, from 0 1 experiments that unlock new model capabilities to 1 N industrialization that processes data reliably and efficiently.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* Build and lead a team of Data Product Operations Leads, to spin up and scale data pipelines, from early experiments to production systems that generate high-quality audio data at scale.
* Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how we can evolve and scale delivery capabilities in service of customer needs.
* Continuously monitor and improve pipeline health, spotting issues in sourcing, quality, or process early and owning solutions end-to-end.
* Use metrics to drive decisions, tracking throughput, quality, and cost to guide prioritization and identify where to scale or invest next.
* Work with researchers at leading AI labs to identify new model capabilities and turn them into concrete data workflows and project plans.
* Partner with our internal research team to design and test new data shapes that unlock frontier model capabilities.
* Own outcomes across functions, designing systems, managing execution, unblocking bottlenecks, and ensuring delivery at both prototype and production scale.

**Your background looks like**
------------------------------

* 5 to 10+ years of experience in high-ownership roles (e.g., founder, GM, COO, or strategy/ops at a venture-backed startup).
* Prior experience scaling large-scale operational efforts at high-growth startups or fast-paced companies.
* Technical fluency with data and operations; SQL proficiency required.
* Prior experience designing and scaling systems, processes, and teams across different customer segments and product lines.
* A relentless operator with high standards, bias to action, and strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment.
* Low-ego, collaborative, and mission-driven, focused on team and company success.

**Bonus points if you have**
----------------------------

* Experience in data, ML, or large-scale operations.
* Background in CS, industrial engineering, or similar.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO.
* Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.
* FSA & HSA access.
* 401k access.
* Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.
* Unlimited company-sponsored Barry's classes.

**Visas**
---------

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B *transfers*, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on STEM OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

Compensation Range: $205K - $235K

**Are You a Wastewater Expert Who Knows How to Build a Business?**

We are looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial, results-driven **General Manager – Wastewater Operations** to lead, grow, and transform our **Eastern United States Region.**

This is not a traditional operations management position. This is an opportunity for a proven wastewater leader and business-minded entrepreneur to take ownership of a region, build high-performing teams, strengthen customer partnerships, drive profitable growth, and establish a standard of operational excellence.

At Solution Group, we deliver specialized wastewater treatment solutions, chemical program management, and operational expertise to some of the most demanding industrial environments in the country, including dairy processing, rendering, and food and beverage manufacturing.

Our customers depend on us to solve complex wastewater challenges, maintain regulatory compliance, improve treatment performance, and reduce operating costs. We need a leader who understands these challenges firsthand and has the technical credibility, business acumen, and leadership presence to take our regional operations to the next level.

**We are looking for a leader who thinks like an owner, operates like an expert, and leads like an entrepreneur.**

**THE OPPORTUNITY: OWN IT. GROW IT. LEAD IT.**

As General Manager, you will have full accountability for the performance and growth of your assigned region. You will lead a multi-site wastewater operation with accountability for financial performance, customer relationships, business development, operational execution, safety, and talent development.

You will have the autonomy and accountability to make an impact, identify opportunities, challenge the status quo, and build a stronger, more profitable business.

Your mission is to create a high-performing regional organization that consistently delivers exceptional wastewater treatment results, outstanding customer experiences, strong financial performance, and a culture of accountability.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

**1. Business Growth & Entrepreneurial Leadership**

* Take ownership of regional growth, identifying new customers, developing market opportunities, and expanding our presence within existing accounts.
* Build executive-level customer relationships that create trust, strengthen retention, and generate new business.
* Identify opportunities to introduce additional services, technologies, and revenue streams across existing customer locations.
* Partner with Business Development, Key Account Managers, and Technical Services to win new business and successfully launch new customer operations.
* Explore strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and opportunities to expand our regional footprint.
* Develop and execute a regional growth strategy with measurable revenue and profitability targets.

**2. Full P&L Ownership & Financial Performance**

* Own the financial performance of the region, including revenue, EBITDA, labor, chemicals, materials, maintenance, and capital expenditures.
* Drive profitable growth through disciplined financial management, cost optimization, and operational accountability.
* Establish clear financial expectations and performance metrics throughout the organization.
* Develop accurate forecasts, budgets, and action plans to improve business performance.
* Communicate financial results, opportunities, challenges, and corrective actions to executive leadership.

**3. Wastewater Expertise & Operational Excellence**

* Provide strategic and technical leadership across a portfolio of industrial wastewater treatment operations.
* Leverage your deep wastewater knowledge to improve treatment performance, process stability, compliance, and operating efficiency.
* Establish consistent operating standards, SOPs, preventive maintenance programs, and performance metrics across all locations.
* Drive standardization and best-practice implementation while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
* Lead troubleshooting and problem-solving efforts on complex wastewater treatment challenges.
* Champion continuous improvement, root cause analysis, process optimization, and operational discipline.

**4. Customer Leadership & Retention**

* Own the overall customer experience and build long-term, trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders.
* Maintain a strong customer retention rate through proactive engagement, exceptional service delivery, and measurable results.
* Lead strategic customer business reviews and identify opportunities to deliver additional value.
* Partner with Key Account Managers to ensure customer expectations are consistently met and exceeded.
* Position Solution Group as a strategic wastewater partner, not simply a service provider.

**5. Safety, Compliance & Operational Discipline**

* Establish a culture where safety, environmental compliance, and operational excellence are non-negotiable.
* Partner with HSE leadership to drive safety performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure all locations maintain strong environmental compliance, documentation, training, and preventative safety practices.
* Champion 5S, workplace organization, and consistent execution of operational standards.
* Lead with visibility, accountability, and a commitment to ensuring every employee goes home safely.

**6. Build, Develop & Inspire High-Performing Teams**

* Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional operational leaders and wastewater professionals.
* Lead and coach Key Account Managers, Regional Managers, and Site Managers.
* Establish clear expectations, performance goals, and accountability throughout the region.
* Develop succession plans and create opportunities for employees to grow into greater leadership responsibilities.
* Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and results.
* Lead by example and inspire teams to take pride in their work, their customers, and their performance.

**7. Enterprise Leadership & Collaboration**

* Work closely with other General Managers and corporate leadership to share best practices and drive company-wide success.
* Collaborate with Technical Services, Business Development, Sales, HR, Finance, and HSE to strengthen capabilities and execute strategic initiatives.
* Contribute to the long-term growth, scalability, and success of Solution Group.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a strong, confident, entrepreneurial leader who brings together deep technical wastewater expertise, proven operational leadership, and a genuine passion for building a business.

**You are someone who:**

* Knows wastewater treatment. You understand industrial wastewater processes, treatment systems, troubleshooting, chemistry, compliance, and the operational challenges our customers face.
* Thinks like a business owner. You understand P&L performance, revenue growth, cost control, and what it takes to build a profitable operation.
* Is commercially driven. You naturally identify opportunities, build relationships, grow accounts, and turn customer challenges into business opportunities.
* Leads with confidence. You know how to build trust, set expectations, develop people, and hold teams accountable.
* Is operationally disciplined. You believe in KPIs, standardization, preventative maintenance, continuous improvement, and measurable results.
* Is entrepreneurial. You are energized by growth, change, new opportunities, and the ability to make a meaningful impact.
* Is a problem solver. You are comfortable navigating complex operational challenges and making decisions in a fast-paced environment.
* Is collaborative. You understand that regional success contributes to company-wide success.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in industrial wastewater treatment, environmental services, industrial services, utilities, or related operational environments.
* Demonstrated expertise in industrial wastewater treatment operations, including treatment processes, troubleshooting, environmental compliance, and emerging technologies.
* Proven experience leading multi-site or regional operations with direct leadership responsibility for multiple levels of management.
* Previous full P&L ownership with demonstrated success improving profitability and financial performance.
* A track record of growing revenue, expanding customer relationships, and developing new business opportunities.
* Experience building and implementing operational standards, KPIs, SOPs, audit programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and accountability.
* Experience with Lean, TPM, 5S, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, customer relationship, and change management skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel 50% or more throughout the Eastern US Region.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Business, Operations, or a related discipline.
* State-issued wastewater operator license (Class A, B, C, or D, as applicable).
* Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certifications.
* Experience with mergers, acquisitions, and business integration.

**WHY SOLUTION GROUP?**

At Solution Group, you won't simply inherit a job description and maintain the status quo. You will have the opportunity to influence the direction of a growing business, develop exceptional teams, strengthen customer partnerships, and make a measurable impact on our future.

We offer:

* **Executive-Level Compensation:** $140,000–$200,000 base salary, plus eligibility for an annual performance bonus.
* **Meaningful Leadership:** Full regional ownership and the opportunity to directly influence business performance and strategy.
* **Entrepreneurial Opportunity:** The ability to identify opportunities, drive growth, and help shape the future of the organization.
* **Strong Team Environment:** Work alongside experienced wastewater professionals and collaborative corporate leadership.
* **Competitive Benefits:** Health, dental, vision, 401k, Paid Time Off.
* **Professional Development:** Continued technical training and opportunities for career advancement.
* **Travel Reimbursement:** Mileage reimbursement for business travel.

**THE BOTTOM LINE**

**We are looking for a wastewater expert who is ready to lead a business, not just manage operations.**

If you have the technical depth to understand complex wastewater challenges, the business acumen to drive profitable growth, and the leadership ability to build exceptional teams, we want to hear from you.

**Come build something great with Solution Group.**

*Solution Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected status under applicable federal, state, or local laws.*

protected_roles.description:
As the
**Director of Quality**
, you will lead the quality strategy and continuous improvement efforts across all Bison manufacturing sites. You will be responsible for ensuring that the products meet or exceed customer expectations, industry standards, and regulatory requirements while driving overall quality performance and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to establish and maintain effective quality systems, drive process improvements, and ensure compliance with industry certifications.
  
  
This position can be based at either our
**Whitsett, NC**
or
**Reynosa, MX**
facility.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
  
  

* Leadership & Strategy

+ Develop and execute a strategic quality plan in alignment with business unit goals.
+ Lead, mentor, and develop a team of quality professionals across two locations, ensuring consistency in processes and objectives.
+ Champion a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* Quality Management Systems (QMS)

+ Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and improvement of the QAD Elements QMS and other relevant Quality Management Systems at both locations. Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry-specific quality standards (e.g., FDA, ISO, AS9100, etc.).
+ Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of quality management systems and propose enhancements to improve overall performance.

* Process & Product Quality

+ Collaborate with sales, operations, engineering, and supply chain teams to identify drive resolution of quality issues, ensuring process and product integrity.
+ Support root cause analysis and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for internal and external quality issues.
+ Oversee first article inspections, process capability studies, and validation/qualification activities to ensure robust manufacturing processes.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Lead Lean Six Sigma or other continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing defects, enhancing efficiency, and improving overall quality.
+ Implement data-driven decision-making tools (e.g., SPC, FMEA, Control Plans) to monitor and improve process capabilities.
+ Facilitate cross-functional value stream mapping sessions and quality workshops to drive process improvements.

* Customer & Supplier Relations

+ Serve as the main point of contact for customer quality issues, audits, and feedback, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
+ Oversee supplier quality management, including audits, performance monitoring, and supplier development initiatives.

* Metrics & Reporting

+ Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to quality performance, including scrap/rework, defect rates, customer complaints, and audit findings.
+ Regularly report quality performance metrics to senior leadership, highlighting trends and recommending corrective actions.

* Regulatory Compliance & Audits

+ Lead internal and external audits, ensuring the sites comply with relevant standards and certifications.
+ Ensure the manufacturing facilities are audit-ready at all times and coordinate responses to audit findings.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience with quality management systems (ISO 9001, AS9100, FDA, or equivalent) and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma).
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
* Proven track record of driving quality improvements across multi-site operations.
* Ability to travel as needed to the BU manufacturing sites (up to 30%)
* Strong leadership and team-building skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization.
* Proficiency in quality tools such as SPC, FMEA, 8D, and Root Cause Analysis.

**Compensation**
Employee Type: Salaried
  
  
Currency: USD
  
  
Salary Minimum: 135,000
  
  
Salary Maximum: 185,000
  
  
Incentive: Yes
  
  
Disclaimer: Where a specific pay range is noted, it is a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. The actual salary offered will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, market / business considerations, and geographic location.

****Job Description:****
**Are you ready to steer quality operations for a global leader in vertical flight?**
Airbus Helicopters is seeking a visionary, results-oriented
**Site Quality Director**
to lead our site-level Quality Management System (QMS) and daily operational integrity. Reporting directly to the VP of Quality, you will serve as the operational anchor for aviation safety, manufacturing excellence, and regulatory compliance across FAA, EASA, TCCA, and AS9100 standards.
  
  
In this high-visibility leadership role, you will direct a team of quality professionals across logistics, assembly, component repair, and final conformity. We are looking for a strategic change-maker who can embed a "First Time Right" mindset, harmonize site practices with global Airbus standards, and bridge the gap between engineering, regulatory bodies, and frontline operations.
  
  
**Your working environment:**
On the eastern border of Mississippi you’ll find Columbus, home to our Helicopter manufacturing and assembly lines and Center of Excellence for the entire North America region. It’s here that we produce the UH-72A Lakota Helicopters for the U.S. Army in addition to the H-125 aircraft for civil and commercial customers.
  
  
**How we care for you:**

* Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
* Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.
* Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
* Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility.

**Your Challenges:**

* Sustain Regulatory & Quality Certifications: Maintain, uphold, and expand site compliance for FAA, EASA, and TCCA repair station and production certificates, certified personnel, and AS9100 QMS credentials.
* Drive Executive QMS Governance: Administer the site Quality Management System, collaborating directly with the Executive Committee to embed strategic quality objectives into the business planning cycle.
* Standardize Operational Inspections: Supervise and enforce rigorous inspection standards across supply chain, logistics, receiving, in-process assembly, quality gates, and final aircraft conformity for components, aerostructures, and rotorcraft.
* Mitigate Quality Escapes & Risk: Identify and eliminate operational and airworthiness risks to safeguard customer flight safety, business continuity, delivery schedules, and operating costs.
* Lead and Develop Personnel: Directly manage, mentor, and evaluate a team of 3-5 exempt supervisors/engineers and 10-25 non-exempt inspectors, directing career progression, staffing, and technical competence.
* Establish & Track SQCDP KPIs: Implement robust enterprise metrics tracking Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, and People (SQCDP) to systematically capture non-conformances, process capability, and customer complaints.
* Manage Financials & Quality Budget: Direct departmental budgeting, manage financial forecasts, analyze cost variances, and allocate capital for advanced measurement tools, calibration, and ergonomic work environments.
* Execute Root Cause & Corrective Action (RCCA): Drive practical problem solving (PPS), Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA), and structured RCCA workflows to resolve manufacturing anomalies and prevent recurrence.
* Harmonize Global Airbus Standards: Coordinate with international Airbus Helicopters facilities to standardize quality procedures, digital architectures, and enterprise systems (including SAP, MES, and non-conformance portals).
* Champion Safety and "First Time Right" Culture: Spearhead a proactive, psychological safety culture anchored by "First Time Right" execution and a robust "Speak Up / Listen Up" mindset across all shifts and departments.
* Direct Internal & External Audits: Lead preparation, execution, and reporting for internal, regulatory (FAA/EASA/TCCA), and customer audits, ensuring all corrective action milestones are closed transparently.
* Collaborate on Design & New Product Introduction (NPI): Partner with design engineering and certification teams to support new product development, configuration integrity, obsolescence management, and manufacturing build cycles.
* Reduce Cost of Non-Quality (CoNQ): Lead enterprise continuous improvement, Lean, and Kaizen initiatives to eliminate scrap, minimize rework, reduce the Cost of Non-Quality, and improve delivery reliability.
* Optimize Workload & Production Flow: Coordinate with operations and program management to balance inspection staffing and shift priorities against critical flightline and customer delivery schedules.
* Oversee Technical Training & Qualifications: Build and finance comprehensive onboarding and recurrent training programs covering aviation safety, specialized processes (NDI, composites, dynamic components), and regulatory requirements.

**Your Boarding Pass:**

* Must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Aerospace/Aviation/Industrial Engineer/Engineering related field or equivalent experience (4 years)
* Have ten (10) + years of Aerospace/Aviation Industry, Military or Quality experience and three (3) + years in a Leadership role, Civilian and/or Military
* Able to support functions in multiple areas such as repair station, manufacturing, composites, electrical/avionics Backshop, warehousing/logistics, dynamic component repair, blades and tail boom
* Knowledge of Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Regulations 14 CFR Parts 21, 43 and 145 in addition the related sections for Transport Canada and EASA
* Knowledge of AS9100 Quality Requirements and Systems
* Knowledge of aircraft design, maintenance, and manufacturing processes and build cycles
* Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Access), Onbase, Orion eTechPub, Adobe Acrobat , SAP, Smartsheet, G Suite. OCE/ARAS/Bflow T.I.P.I.

**Preferred Education/Skills:**

* Master’s Degree as described above
* 12 years of Aerospace/Aviation Industry, Military or Quality experience and 3 years in a Leadership role Civilian and/or Military
* A&P License
* ASQ or CMQ certified

**Travel Required:**

* 15% Domestic and International

**Citizenship:**

* Must be a US Person under ITAR definition (U.S. Citizen, green card holder or person covered under our existing ITAR license)

**Physical Requirements:**

* Onsite or remote: 100% in Columbus, MS unless traveling
* Vision: able to see and read computer screens and other electronic equipment with screens, able to read documents, reports and engineering drawings daily. Must have correctable near and far vision if applicable.
* Hearing: able to hear to participate in conversations in person and via teleconference or phone and to hear sounds on the production floor including safety warnings or alarms. Daily
* Speaking: able to speak in conversations and meetings, deliver information and participate in communications. Daily
* Equipment Operation (personal computer, telephone, copies, fax machine, and related office equipment and using electronic identification card to enter building floors and internal doors): able to operate most office and personal electronic equipment and some tools including production tools .
* Carrying: able to carry documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs. Daily
* Lifting: able to lift documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs. Daily
* Pushing / Pulling: able to push and pull small office furniture and some equipment and tools. Daily
* Sitting: able to sit for long periods of time in meetings, working on the computer. Several times a week
* Squatting / Kneeling: able to squat or kneel to retrieve or replace items stored on low shelving. Daily
* Standing: able to stand for discussions in offices or on the production floor. Daily
* Travel: able to travel independently and at short notice. 15% or less yearly
* Walking (include routine walking such as to a shared printer to retrieve documents): able to walk through office and production areas including uneven surfaces. Daily
* Personal Protective Equipment required: Required PPE includes, but is not limited to, Safety Shoes, Safety Glasses, Hearing Protection, Respirators/Masks, and/or Protective Gloves as required by site and/or customer site
* Administrative position only PPE required: Steel-toed shoes are required for all shop floor visits, appropriate hearing/eye protection may also be required when visiting the shop floor.

**Company Overview**
Red 6 is an innovative Augmented Reality (AR) technology startup leading the way in synthetic air combat training. Our primary technology, supporting our ATARS product, enables pilots to simulate the cognitive challenges of flying while accessing realistic, scalable training in dynamic outdoor environments.
  
  
**Director of Quality**
Lead Red 6 into a scalable aerospace product organization.
  
  
Red 6 develops advanced augmented reality capabilities for aerospace and defense applications. We seek a hands-on, strategic Director of Quality to lead the next phase of our evolution into disciplined, repeatable product qualification and production. This leader will strengthen existing foundations while guiding the processes, evidence, and behaviors needed to meet customer, regulatory, safety, and aerospace industry expectations.
  
  
Success requires more than maintaining certifications. The Director will embed quality planning into product development, improve manufacturing and supplier readiness, and create a culture in which teams jointly solve problems before they become defects, delays, or compliance findings. Key results are building practical, auditable quality processes with Quality as a trusted partner across Engineering, Operations, Programs, and the supplier base.
  
  
**What You Will Lead**

* Own the enterprise Quality strategy and roadmap, scaling the Quality Management System (QMS) to match product maturity, production volume, and customer commitments.
* Maintain and continuously improve AS9100 certification and audit readiness. Lead management reviews, internal audits, corrective action effectiveness, risk based thinking, and process ownership.
* Lead ISO 45001 occupational health and safety management system maturation and certification readiness, in coordination with accountable safety and operations leaders.
* Deploy practical Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) disciplines aligned to AS9145 where applicable, including quality planning, process flow, PFMEA, control plans, measurement system analysis, first article inspection, and production readiness reviews.
* Integrate Quality into design inputs, reviews, verification and validation, configuration control, design changes, manufacturing transitions, and product release criteria.
* Establish scalable document and record controls, product pedigree, serial level traceability, inspection and test evidence, nonconformance controls, material review, CAPA, and calibration systems.
* Develop supplier qualification, surveillance, performance scorecards, supplier corrective actions, and risk based oversight of contract manufacturers and critical suppliers.

**About This Role**
The Head of Corporate Quality is responsible for creating and managing the Global Biogen Quality Management System (QMS). The main areas of focus include Quality Systems, internal and external audits for cGMP compliance (including external vendors and CMOs), IT Quality, Technical Product Complaints, and Central Knowledge Management (including documentation).
  
  
This role is central to Quality and PO&T, managing risk, compliance performance, staying compliant with regulatory changes, and seeking opportunities to gain efficiency and effectiveness in the administration of PO&T’s cGMP systems. Additionally, the role is accountable for preparing semi-annual executive-level updates on the state of Biogen’s QMS and informing Executive Management of potential business risks due to a changing regulatory environment or systemic issues within the company. This role also serves as the principal liaison with the R&D Clinical Compliance organization and provides guidance for ICH conformance. Oversight includes biologic products, ASOs, small molecule products, gene therapy, devices, digital, and combination products.
  
  
*This role is hybrid- RTP or hybrid- Cambridge based.*
**Travel requirements**
: 25% – 50% depending on location. More travel required if not located in RTP.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Implement integrated quality systems, policies, and standards applicable to all Biogen U.S. and international manufacturing sites and PO&T locations, including Baar, Cambridge, Netherlands, Solothurn, and RTP.
* Develop and maintain a risk assessment process for evaluating and monitoring all cGXP systems.
* Ensure regulatory inspection responses are assessed holistically.
* Establish clear goals and effective metrics that provide insight into industry benchmarks and applicable trends regarding cGMP compliance.
* Oversee external monitoring of regulatory updates (domestic and international) and incorporate changes into Biogen’s QMS as needed.
* Internal and external GxP and ISO audit programs, including risk management and audit program oversight.
* Ensure Biogen’s internal manufacturing sites, Quality Systems, and vendors operate in a state of cGMP compliance, with any risks appropriately communicated and escalated.

**IT QA Department**

* Oversee GxP IT computerized systems across Biogen, including underlying infrastructure.
* Define appropriate standards and manage lifecycle documentation and supporting processes to ensure compliant implementation and management through retirement.

**Lifecycle Management**

* Oversee process and compliance-related content (specifically documentation, including governing policies, process documents, and other similar GxP documents) in the electronic document management system.
* Protect, index, classify, and archive GXP records, digitally preserve vital records, manage records lifecycle, and translate GMP content needed in multiple languages.
* Oversee the PO&T training program, providing global guidance and standards to ensure appropriate GxP training is conducted.

**Technical Product Complaint Department**

* Develop and maintain policies and procedures to manage complaints in line with industry and regulatory standards.
* Identify strategy and provide direction to team members regarding complaint investigation, root cause analysis, CAPAs, regulatory responses, and launch readiness for new products.
* Ensure trending and reporting of complaint cases and metrics, including appropriate escalation and response to significant events.

**Global Management Review (GMR)**

* Act as the chair for the GMR, ensuring ongoing management review and awareness of Biogen Quality and compliance performance (in accordance with cGMP and ICH expectations).
* Prepare semi-annual executive-level updates on the state of Biogen’s QMS based on GMR outcomes.
* Establish short and long-term goals, objectives, and strategies for the Global Corporate Quality organization.
* Ensure appropriate policies and procedures are in place to measure, monitor, and report "actual" versus "planned" results.
* Drive major projects and programs for the Organizational Unit or Function to completion within schedule and budget.
* Manage multiple cost centers and determine the development of overall objectives and long-range goals of the organization.
* Interact directly with senior representatives of regulatory agencies, including the FDA and EMEA.
* Manage direct reports and managers of managers to increase their performance and effectiveness.

**Who You Are**
You are a seasoned leader in the pharmaceutical industry with an expert understanding of both U.S. and international regulatory requirements. Your influence within an organization is felt through consistent execution and strong leadership competencies. With excellent communication and change management skills, you're adept at leading and implementing change. You thrive in a highly regulated environment and have comprehensive knowledge of the pharmaceutical product development process.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field with a minimum of 15 years of leadership experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience leading a Quality Assurance, Regulatory, or Corporate organization at the Director+ level in a highly regulated environment, preferably in biotech, pharmaceutical, or similar industry.
* Experience with the FDA, EMEA, and preferably multiple additional regulatory agencies in other foreign countries.
* Experience in clinical and commercial products as well as both large and small molecule programs, device, and combination products is strongly preferred. ASQ or other auditing certification is beneficial.
* Quality and Compliance experience consistent with worldwide regulatory requirements.
* Expert knowledge of US and International cGxPs, ISO, ICH, and Device regulations.
* Ability to hire and retain top talent with a track record of developing leaders.
* Excellent knowledge of the pharmaceutical product development process, ICH, and device regulations.
* Ability to influence the organization through consistent execution of Biogen leadership competencies.
* Strong leadership abilities required to effectively manage highly capable and high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and implement change, including excellent communication and change management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Advanced degree (PharmD, PhD)

Job Level: Management
  
  
**Additional Information**
The base compensation range for this role is: $281,000.00-$397,250.00
  
  
Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.
  
  
Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.
  
  
**Benefits**
In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families
*physical, financial, emotional,*
and
*social well-being*
; including, but not limited to:
  
  

* Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
* Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
* Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
* A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
* Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance

* Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
* 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
* Employee stock purchase plan

**Why Biogen?**
We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.
  
  
At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. Read on to learn more about Biogen.

Cytovale, Inc. | South San Francisco, CA
  
  
**Reports to:**
Chief Operating Officer
  
  
**Function:**
Quality and Regulatory Compliance
  
  
**Location:**
**Bay area, onsite role**
**About Cytovale**
Cytovale is a medical diagnostics company focused on providing a faster, more insightful way to diagnose fast-moving and immune-mediated diseases. Cytovale's IntelliSep test is the first and only stand-alone sepsis detection assay to quickly and accurately analyze white blood cell structure to stratify a patient's risk of sepsis. The test simply and clearly shows risk of sepsis using a biomechanical evaluation of white blood cells from a standard blood draw, generating results in less than 10 minutes. For more information, please visit www.cytovale.com.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Head of Quality and Regulatory owns Cytovale's Quality Management System and serves as the company's designated Management Representative. This leader is accountable for the effectiveness and compliance of the QMS under FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and applicable IEC standards, and for the quality engineering capability that supports design change, process validation, and on-market product improvement for the IntelliSep system and its consumables.
  
  
The role is quality-first with a strong regulatory partnership. Working alongside the Senior Director of Regulatory Affairs, the Head of Quality and Regulatory shapes an 18- to 24-month regulatory roadmap spanning letters to file, Special and Traditional 510(k)s, and Predetermined Change Control Plans (PCCPs), so that product and reliability improvements reach customers predictably and compliantly. The position leads all internal and external audits, third-party registrations, and agency inspections, and is expected to make the organization both more compliant and more nimble.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Strategy and Leadership**

* Define and execute an enterprise Quality strategy that supports regulatory obligations, operational objectives, and long-term growth; establish annual quality objectives and the KPIs used to report progress to executive leadership.
* Lead a multidisciplinary Quality organization spanning Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Design Quality, Quality Systems, Process Validation, Incoming Inspection, and the audit program.
* Set the strategy for quality infrastructure, including eQMS evolution and the application of AI and analytics to quality processes.

**Quality Management System and Compliance**

* Serve as Management Representative; own the effectiveness of the QMS and its core processes, including CAPA, nonconformance and deviation management, complaint handling, change control, document control, training, and management review.
* Drive process improvements that allow the organization to move quickly while maintaining full FDA, ISO, and QMSR compliance, with documentation that is cohesive, consistent, and built on continuous-improvement principles.
* Establish and sustain a disciplined operating rhythm for internal audits, annual post-market reviews, and periodic management reviews.
* Maintain a proactive state of inspection readiness and lead the organization through FDA inspections, Notified Body audits, and third-party registration activities.

**Design Quality, Change Management, and Regulatory Roadmap**

* Direct design quality assurance across product development and design-change programs, allocating resources, managing budgets, and embedding quality engineers in project teams to ensure efficient, compliant execution.
* Partner with the Senior Director of Regulatory Affairs to develop and maintain a forward-looking 18- to 24-month regulatory roadmap covering letters to file, Special and Traditional 510(k)s, and PCCPs that enable feature and reliability improvements.
* Provide subject matter expertise in design of experiments, process validation, statistical methods, software validation, test method validation and measurement systems analysis, risk management and FMEA, and cybersecurity.

**Manufacturing, Supplier, and Product Quality**

* Own the Quality Improvement Plans for the IntelliSep instrument and associated consumables, and partner with Manufacturing and Engineering on qualification, process capability, and design-transfer activities.
* Govern manufacturing process changes with appropriate validation and documentation and ensure nonconformances are investigated and closed promptly.
* Direct the supplier quality program in collaboration with Supply Chain and R&D, including supplier selection and qualification, audits, performance monitoring, and supplier corrective actions.

**Post-Market Surveillance and Continuous Improvement**

* Own the post-market surveillance process end to end, from complaint intake through investigation, trending, product-improvement ticketing, and MDR and vigilance reporting.
* Monitor quality performance through data analysis and trend identification to surface risks early and prioritize improvement initiatives.
* Lead complex investigations and root-cause analyses; strengthen CAPA effectiveness and build organizational capability in structured problem solving.

**People and Culture**

* Build, coach, and develop a high-performing team of quality engineers, quality professionals, and future quality leaders; foster accountability, engagement, and ownership at every level.
* Champion a company-wide culture of quality through hands-on leadership, cross-functional partnership, and visible participation in QE and QMS activities.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering discipline.
* 10+ years of progressive quality leadership in the medical device or IVD industry, with 7+ years of experience managing quality teams and organizational performance.
* Demonstrated success leading a QA/RA function at a small- to mid-sized Class II device company, with an emphasis on process and on-market product improvement.
* Deep working knowledge of FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485, cGMP, and IVD-specific regulatory and quality requirements.
* Track record of leading FDA inspections and Notified Body audits and sustaining inspection readiness.
* Significant experience leading both Quality Assurance and Quality Control organizations, including inspection and test method development and validation.
* Applied expertise in risk analysis, FMEA, Impact/hazard analysis, statistical methods, and process and software validation.
* Proven ability to lead structured problem solving, apply data- and risk-based decision making, and drive sustainable corrective actions.
* Experience driving cultural change and building high-functioning cross-functional teams; thoughtful, analytical, and intellectually curious.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or Master's degree in engineering or related field.
* Hands-on experience with eQMS platforms and AI-enabled quality tools.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Certified internal auditor (ISO 13485) or comparable ASQ certification (CQA, CQE, CMQ/OE).

**Compensation**
Competitive and commensurate with experience.

The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering will own end-to-end manufacturing engineering strategy and execution across the product lifecycle, from new product introduction (NPI) through production ramp and rate manufacturing.
  
  
This role unifies distributed Centers of Excellence (NPI, Additive, Machining, Assembly & Test) under a single technical vision, ensuring seamless part transitions, robust process definition, and achievement of cost, quality, and rate targets.
  
  
The Senior Manager will bring deep expertise in additive manufacturing and serve as a key partner to Design Engineering, using data-driven insights to influence design decisions, drive DFM/DFAM, and optimize lifecycle cost, while leading and mentoring a team of Manufacturing Engineers across multiple sites.

+ Ensure robust manufacturing release readiness, including CTQs, process capability, and transfer gates
+ Lead transition to production, including rate readiness, line balancing, and tooling/fixture readiness

+ Align NPI, Additive, Machining, and Assembly & Test COEs under a unified operating model [AB1]
+ Establish cross-site standards for process definition, handoffs, data traceability, and work instructions
+ Drive repeatability, scalability, and efficiency across geographically distributed teams

+ Serve as the technical authority for additive manufacturing
+ Define print strategies, post-processing workflows, and yield optimization approaches
+ Drive DFAM adoption and ensure outputs are optimized for downstream manufacturing processes

* Design Partnership & DFM

+ Partner with Design Engineering to influence designs using manufacturing data
+ Drive DFM/DFAM and lifecycle cost optimization
+ Establish feedback loops from NPI and production to continuously improve design and manufacturability

* Process Excellence & Performance

+ Develop and standardize tooling strategies, process flows, and validation plans
+ Drive improvements in yield, throughput, cost, and automation
+ Ensure robust process validation prior to production release and sustained operational performance

* Team Leadership

+ Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and direction to Manufacturing Engineers across sites and COEs
+ Support alignment of priorities and execution across a distributed engineering team

* Experience leading or mentoring engineering teams in a multi-site or cross-functional environment
* Experience across NPI, prototyping, production ramp, and high-rate manufacturing

* Demonstrated ability to operate strategically and execute tactically

****Nice to have...****

* Expertise in additive manufacturing (metal AM preferred)
